jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Founded in 1969, Metro Sales Inc. built its reputation selling office supplies and equipment across the Twin Cities. Decades later, we've grown into one of the largest office technology and solutions providers in the Midwest. Today, MSI Metro Sales Inc., a 100% Employee-Owned Company
, stands as an industry leader in hardware, software, and managed services.

MSI Metro Sales Inc.
is seeking an Employee-Owner, Software Developer,
to join our Roseville, MN Managed IT team
. Our team builds for every side of the business, internally and externally for our clients. Under the guidance of a senior developer, you'll write and review code with AI assistance, deploy to Azure via GitHub. Build AI tools and internal software that support our Technicians, Service Desk, and Sales. Utilize Claude or other AI tools that work with our managed services platforms, internal apps and APIs for internal and external customer’s data.

We don't just have jobs, but opportunities to make an impact on our customers every single day. If you're the type of person that loves to make a difference, now is your chance to join us.

Why Join Us!

Opportunity to work with The AI tools we build with, including Claude and Claude Code.

Production work from your first weeks! You'll join a portfolio that is already in production, work with existing templates and build it into larger apps.

AI and Claude enablement: Read-only MCP servers for N-central, Huntress, SentinelOne, ThreatLocker, Avanan, IT Glue and FortiAnalyzer, plus a TypeScript server covering the full ConnectWise Manage API. Team workflow skills, small tools and staff workshop demos. New connectors start from our house template.
Service desk AI: Workflows that categorize and summarize new ConnectWise tickets, then search IT Glue and resolved tickets and write suggestions for the technician.
Automation and data: About 80 n8n workflows for FortiGate backups, upgrades and drift scoring, Teams onboarding notices, dashboards, and syncs between ConnectWise, N-central, IT Glue and Pax8. Including the read-only C#/.NET e-automate API and Python, SQL Server.
Internal apps and tools: Project Management tool (task tree, Kanban, time approval, two-way ConnectWise sync) and the sales pipeline app. Both are TypeScript end to end. In, addition, technician desktop tools: a .NET 8 WPF profile migration front end and a PowerShell wizard.
Azure platform: Bicep IaC with per-app resource groups and budgets, GitHub OIDC deploy identities, and an OpenTelemetry collector sending Claude Code usage telemetry to Azure Monitor.

Key Responsibilities

Build, maintain, verify and secure connectors (MCP servers) that let AI systems work with the internal software stack Build against vendor REST and GraphQL APIs.
Develop from written specs and ship the docs with the code: READMEs, PRDs, decision records, and runbooks.
Develop and maintain n8n workflows for internal and external flows that move data between ConnectWise, N-central, IT Glue, and Microsoft Teams, with dry runs before live changes, error handling, and failure alerts.
Ship features and fixes across our internal apps and APIs, from database migration to UI. Ship changes through a GitHub with tests and code review.
Use Claude Code daily to plan, write, review, and test code, and critically evaluate its output.
Protect credentials and client data with read-only defaults, least privilege, and secrets stored in Key Vault, never in git, logs, or chat.
Partner with technicians, Service Desk, and sales staff to drive improvements.
Enhance our LLM features: prompts, retrieval quality, similarity thresholds, and the guardrails that keep agent output limited to valid values.
Other duties as required.

Minimum Requirements

High school diploma, GED, or equivalent with 1+ year(s) of professional software development or a portfolio of shipped work (internships, open source, freelance, or personal projects with real users), or a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or equivalent.
1+ year (or equivalent coursework) integrating REST APIs (authentication, pagination, rate limits, retries, error handling) and writing SQL in PostgreSQL or SQL Server.
Working knowledge:
Python: packaging and virtual environments, type hints, HTTP clients, pytest.
Git and GitHub: branches, pull requests, code review, reading a failed CI run.
Command line: PowerShell and Bash.
SQL: joins, indexes, schema migrations.
A second language, ideally TypeScript or C#.

Versed in security basics: keeping secrets out of source control, how OAuth/OIDC sign-in works at a high level.
This position is onsite, 5 days a week at our Roseville location; relocation is not budgeted for this role, local candidates will be given priority consideration.
Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S without requiring sponsorship now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building MCP servers, Claude skills, or AI agents that use tools, LLM APIs or AI coding assistants.
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and measuring whether retrieval improves output.
Azure: Container Apps, Key Vault, Entra ID app registrations, Application Insights, or infrastructure as code in Bicep or Terraform.
Exposure to workflow automation in n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools and Docker and GitHub Actions pipelines.
MSP platforms: ConnectWise Manage, N-central, IT Glue, Huntress, or SentinelOne.
Web development with React and a Node backend (Fastify or Express) and an ORM such as Drizzle or Prisma.
C# and .NET beyond the basics: ASP.NET Core web APIs, WPF desktop apps, or PowerShell modules tested with Pester.
Supported Help desk, networking, or systems administration.
OpenTelemetry or other observability tooling.
Strong written communication, including clear documentation and pull request descriptions.

Candidates with
a shareable link of the code written (GitHub, a portfolio, or a project write-up) any builds with an LLM or AI coding tool, will be prioritized.

What We Offer

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
Short- and Long-Term Disability Program
Life Insurance
Educational Development Benefits
Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) + Gainshare - because your success is also your investment
401(k) + Match
Paid Time Off (PTO)
Paid Volunteer Days! - give back alongside your peers in the community

Compensation Range: $70,000 - $90,000 per year

MSI Metro Sales Inc. Vision

Our Employee-Owners
are the engine behind everything we achieve. We're committed to building an environment that offers meaningful challenges, continuous growth, and real financial rewards. When you join MSI, you're not just taking a job; you're building a career and investing in something you can call your own.

All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future visa sponsorship needs or requirements. MSI does not sponsor any type of employment visas, including but not limited to H1B, F1, OPT/CPT, TN, or other work authorization programs at this time.

All offers of employment are contingent on successfully completing MSI's standard pre-employment screenings.

Notice to Recruiters and Placement Agencies

MSI will not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or placement agencies unless an approved service agreement is in place. In the event MSI receives an unsolicited resume without a current service agreement in place, MSI will not be obligated to pay a service fee of any amount nor will MSI be held liable to terms or conditions under any agreement of any kind that has not been authorized in writing by an MSI Representative.

MSI Metro Sales Inc.
is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will provide equal opportunity regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, marital status, disability, familial status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status with regard to public assistance or any other protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

The primary responsibilities of this software engineering position include design, development, test and delivery of software with potential applications including tactical decision aids, radar software, flight software, and physics-based model development. Other general application areas include modeling, simulation, frameworks, and the transition and deployment of advanced technology algorithms .Positions available ranging from junior software engineers to senior software engineers.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field;
All levels of experience in software engineering and development including design, development & test;
Experience in various software languages including ADA, C, C++, python, etc.;
Active DoD Secret clearance;
Must be a US Citizen.

Desired Qualifications

Battle management software experience;
Experience in ADA;
Experience in numerical methods;
Solid communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical ideas into understandable, actionable information for customers.

Location: Huntsville, AL

jobs.title: Sr. Backend Software Engineer (Infrastructure ML Ops)
jobs.description:
At Philo, we’re a group of technology and product people who set out to build the future of television, marrying the best in modern technology with the most compelling medium ever invented — in short, we’re building the TV experience that we’ve always wanted for ourselves. In practice this means leveraging cloud delivery, modern tech stacks, machine learning, and hand-crafted native app experiences on all of our platforms. We aim to deliver a rock solid experience on the streaming basics, while cooking up next generation multi-screen and multi-user playback experiences.

Senior Backend Software Engineer (Infrastructure MLOps)

The infrastructure team at Philo builds the foundation for a 24/7 live and on-demand streaming product serving video to our growing subscriber base. It provides a platform that enables groups across the company – such as video delivery, product, support, and analytics – to do their best work easily and smoothly. Our systems are highly distributed, horizontally scalable and run in the cloud on Kubernetes. We continuously test and deploy our code and closely monitor the health and performance of our production environment.

We are seeking an enthusiastic Infrastructure MLOps Software Engineer to help us build and improve the ML infrastructure at Philo. We are building out ML and LLM infrastructure and this role will be pivotal in setting direction, adopting best practices, and shipping infrastructure that will be used across the company.

As a sample, the ML infrastructure supports teams like Discovery in building content recommendation models that will help our users find more favorite shows from the large Philo catalog. The engineering team is designing and developing our own agent harnesses to support coding and empowering everyone at the company to get answers across our code bases, analytics, logs, and communication tools. The video player team is using LLMs to classify ads and label our video catalog so that users have a better experience. You’ll build the serving, evaluation and platform infrastructure that these workloads depend on.

Responsibilities

Manage the core infrastructure at Philo with a focus on supporting ML and LLM workloads. This infrastructure is relied on by a large subscriber base of Philo’s product as well as internal stakeholders across the company.
Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure components (AWS and Kubernetes) using a combination of in-house technology and open source software.
Build and scale model serving and inference infrastructure for both real-time recommendation models and LLM workloads — including model servers (e.g. NVIDIA Triton), LLM inference engines (e.g. vLLM, TGI, TensorRT-LLM), autoscaling, and latency/throughput optimization.
Manage GPU and accelerator infrastructure on Kubernetes — scheduling, capacity and quota management, and cost optimization across on-demand and spot capacity.
Design, build, and maintain monitoring and observability systems — spanning both system health and model quality (drift, evaluation, and online performance) — that enable Philo engineers and the support team to gain insight and to discover and debug issues.
Build and operate model evaluation infrastructure: offline and online eval pipelines, golden/regression datasets, LLM-as-judge harnesses, A/B testing and experimentation, and feedback/ground-truth loops
Design, build, and maintain CI/CD systems enabling Philo engineers to create pipelines to test and deploy their code.
Establish tools, methods and best practices for other Philo engineers interfacing with the Philo ML infrastructure. Ensure reliability, security, and scalability of the Philo platform. Promote Infrastructure as Code.
Work closely with other Philo engineers to deploy and instrument software systems.
Drive evaluation, selection, and integration of third-party vendor systems and work closely with vendors to configure and manage them.

Qualifications

8+ years of software development and infrastructure management experience.
4+ years of experience developing and deploying ML systems at scale across training and inference
Experience working with distributed systems and an understanding of microservices architecture principles.
Experience with Linux and containerized (i.e. Docker) environments.
Experience managing cloud computing environments (AWS or GCP) and configuring cloud services e.g. CloudWatch, Route 53, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS, ALB/NLB/ELB, VPC networking, IAM security.
Experience with container orchestration platforms (i.e. Kubernetes), and familiarity with running GPU/accelerated workloads on them (e.g. NVIDIA device plugin, MIG, timeslicing).
Strong understanding of networking and internet application protocols including, but not limited to TCP/IP, DNS, and HTTP.
Strong understanding of network and application security principles and best practices.
Familiarity or hands-on experience with configuration management systems and Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation).
Familiarity or hands-on experience with Monitoring/Observability systems (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, TICK/InfluxDB, Fluentd, ELK, Datadog).
Familiarity or hands-on experience with CI/CD automation systems e.g. Jenkins, Gitlab.
Experience with relational and non-relational databases and familiarity with modern data warehousing and querying.
Proficient in writing, testing, and profiling software in Golang, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, Ruby, Python or similar programming languages.
Experience and aptitude for collaborating and communicating with internal and external stakeholders in both business and technical roles.

A strong candidate may also have one or more of these:

Hands-on experience optimizing inference — dynamic/continuous batching, quantization, KV-cache management, or GPU memory tuning — for low-latency or highthroughput serving.
Experience with ML platform tooling: model registry and experiment tracking (e.g. MLflow, Weights & Biases), feature stores (e.g. Feast, Tecton), and pipeline/workflow orchestration (e.g. Airflow, Dagster, Kubeflow, Ray, Metaflow).
Experience building model evaluation, monitoring, or experimentation systems — including drift detection, LLM-as-judge, or A/B testing for models.
Experience with LLMOps: inference gateways/routers (e.g. LiteLLM), hosted model APIs (Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic), RAG pipelines, vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate), and prompt/version management.
Experience building or operating agent harnesses or tool-using LLM applications in production.
Experience with data and model versioning (e.g. DVC, LakeFS) and data/labeling pipelines.
Experience with cost management / FinOps for GPU and inference workloads

We are language agnostic, but most of our backend code is written in Golang, Ruby and TypeScript, with some C++ and Python. Our services run on Kubernetes, and we practice continuous deployment across all of our systems.

More About Philo

At Philo, we’re a company that puts people first—both our subscribers and our team. We empower our colleagues to do their best work while supporting one another in pursuing shared goals. We value pragmatism, pride in our work, and passion, with transparency and openness as fundamental parts of our culture.

We’re committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility as we grow the Philo team and shape the future of TV. We believe that a diverse range of voices and perspectives enables us to innovate faster and create the best experiences for our subscribers. Philo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to supporting every candidate and employee. If you need an accommodation at any stage of the process, please email recruiting@philo.com
and we’ll work with you to meet your needs.

Philo offers 70+ top-rated networks, including AMC, BET, CMT, Comedy Central, Discovery Channel, Food Network, Hallmark Channel, HGTV, HISTORY, Investigation Discovery, Lifetime, MTV, Nickelodeon, OWN, VH1, We TV, and more. It also includes all the groundbreaking originals and blockbuster movies available with AMC+ and access to HBO Max Basic With Ads and discovery+. Our service also includes 100+ free channels and premium add-ons like STARZ and MGM+.

Our extensive library boasts over 85,000 titles, and our unlimited DVR allows users to save their favorite shows and movies for up to a year, skipping ads for a seamless viewing experience. Stream on up to three devices simultaneously, whether on your phone, tablet, laptop, or TV using Roku, Apple TV, Fire TV, Samsung TV, Android TV, Vizio TV, or Chromecast.

Philo is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices in New York City and Cambridge, MA. Our leadership team includes alums from HBO, Tubi, and Meraki, and is backed by NEA and industry partners like Warner Brothers Discovery, Paramount, AMC, and A&E.

Join us at Philo and be part of a team that's shaping the future of TV!

Status:
Full-time

Location:
San Francisco, CA, Brooklyn, NY, Cambridge, MA, or remote

Compensation:
Includes annual salary, company stock options, and health benefits. Salary is determined by experience and location:

San Francisco, New York City: $195K - $250K
Boston, DC Metro, Los Angeles, Seattle: $185K - $240K
Denver, Atlanta, Austin, Las Vegas, Sacramento, Chicago: $175K - $230K
Texas, Florida: $165K - $220K

Benefits

We value a diverse and inclusive workplace and we welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, skills, and perspectives. Philo is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that everyone does their best work when they are supported by each other and the company, and we offer a generous set of benefits to make sure the Philo team is happy and healthy. Here is a sampling of the benefits we offer our team:

Full health, dental and vision coverage for you and your family
401(k) plan with employer contributions (we match 100% of deferrals up to 3% of pay and 50% of the next 2% of pay)
Flexible working hours
Up to 20 weeks of fully paid parental leave
Unlimited paid time off for vacation and sick leave
$2,000 annual vacation bonus (we pay you to take a two week vacation)
$5,250 annually for professional development and educational assistance
$1,250 annual home office + TV stipend during first year of employment ($250 annually thereafter)
$500/month ($6,000/year) bonus for employees who commit to working at least 3 days per week in our offices, plus generous commuter benefits ($315/month towards transit, rideshare, bike rental, or parking at our HQ office in San Francisco)
Free Gympass subscription — an all-in-one corporate benefit that gives employees the largest selection of gyms, studios, classes, training and wellness apps
Dog-friendly office
And much more!

For California Residents: Philo’s CCPA Notice at Collection – Employees, Applicants, Owners, Directors, Officers and Contractors

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Use of Automated Tools in Our Hiring Process

We use software tools, including our applicant tracking system (Ashby), to help manage applications for this role. Automated features (i) assess the skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role as described in this posting, and (ii) flag applications that appear fraudulent, duplicative, or not genuinely submitted by the applicant.

What You’ll Do

The SoC Architect team proposes multiple SoC level architecture candidates for emerging memory/storage solution and demonstrates that the proposed architecture is viable through hands-on RTL implementation.

This role offers the opportunity to shape next-generation SoC and subsystem architectures while staying deeply hands-on in RTL design, FPGA integration, and validation. It is ideal for engineers who want to turn advanced memory and storage concepts into real hardware and drive them all the way to silicon.

Location:

Senior Director

Deploy and operate an LLM inference service (vLLM serving Llama-3.3-70B) on a 4 × NVIDIA H200 GPU server, working closely with your mentor and the storage architecture team.
Build an automated benchmark harness that replays long-context, multi-turn and agent-style request traces and records latency and throughput (TTFT, TPOT, goodput).
Configure KV cache offloading (LMCache, NVIDIA Dynamo/NIXL) to network-attached storage over NVMe-oF and RDMA, first on a BlueField-3 storage server and then on our network-attached SSD prototype.
Run daily experiment sweeps across request rates, context lengths and cache sizes, keeping every configuration and result reproducible in git.
Analyze results with Python to find bottlenecks across the GPU, network and SSD, and share findings in weekly team meetings.
Collaborate with FPGA, SoC and firmware engineers to debug the end-to-end data path and validate KV cache correctness.
Summarize the measured storage requirements (bandwidth, IOPS, latency) that shape the architecture of future SSD controllers, and present them to the team at the end of the internship.
Complete other responsibilities as assigned.

Pursuing Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field preferred.

Understanding of LLM serving internals: KV cache, prefix caching, batching and parallelism (tensor/pipeline), and latency metrics such as TTFT, TPOT and throughput.
Experience benchmarking and profiling system performance, and analyzing results with scripts (e.g., Python, pandas, plotting) to explain bottlenecks.
Familiarity with KV cache offloading (LMCache, NVIDIA Dynamo/NIXL), RDMA/RoCE or NVMe/NVMe-oF storage, and containers (Docker/Kubernetes) preferred.

jobs.title: Data Engineering Internship, Summer 2027
jobs.description:
About Us:

Perpay is a certified B Corp and Philadelphia’s most impactful growth-stage startup. We are driven by a mission to significantly improve the financial stability of everyday Americans. For the past decade, we have established strong product-market fit and a profitable, efficient operating model across a suite of products, positioning Perpay as the premier financial partner for consumers with subprime credit.

With over 500,000 customers who have utilized more than $1 billion in spending power, we are at a pivotal moment. We are scaling our operations, building new offerings, and deepening our impact. We are looking for teammates eager to join us on this journey.

Our venture partners include First Round Capital and L Catterton.

Products we’ve built to make an impact:

Perpay Marketplace: Combines interest-free payments and modern e-commerce to reduce cost of ownership and promote healthy repayment behavior.
Perpay+: Leverages Marketplace repayment history to help members monitor and build credit with all 3 credit bureaus.
Perpay Credit Card: Expands access to the flexibility and benefits of a World Mastercard by removing common barriers like high security deposits and low approval odds.

Our team thrives on in-person collaboration, operating from our unique center-city Philadelphia office. This comfortable "home away from home" space offers river views and fosters rapid product development, strong relationships, and career growth. The energy from achieving big wins is palpable here. While we primarily work in the office, we offer sensible flexibility for personal needs, such as sick children or urgent errands, and coordinate official remote weeks around major holidays. If you are passionate about a meaningful mission, collaboration, equity, and generous perks, Perpay is the best place to be in Philadelphia right now.

About the Role:

Our data team is organized across three groups: Data Engineering, Data Science, and Strategic Analytics. Data Engineering owns the warehouse, the orchestration layer, and the pipelines that move data from our operational systems to everyone who depends on it. This year, with the credit portfolio scaling and our modeling needs getting heavier, focus areas include real-time event ingestion, the risk decisioning service redesign, AI-agent data access on Redshift Serverless, ERP/EDI standardization with Finance and Accounting, and AI-assisted workflows across the engineering lifecycle.

As a Data Engineering intern, your main responsibility is to learn, but you'll learn it by doing real work. During the summer of 2027, you'll build data pipelines, help design tools and infrastructure for analyzing large volumes of data, and work through real data warehousing problems alongside the team that owns them. Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex technical challenges and propose scalable solutions.

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and associated PaaS services (e.g., Azure Functions, AKS, API Management) preferred; experience with other cloud platform (AWS, GCP) is also valued.
Proficient in securing APIs, managing authentication/authorization and data privacy practices.
Knowledge of AI ethics and regulations (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act), and commitment to responsible AI development.
Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating across global R&D locations

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the center of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

As an Orbital Software Engineer on Space, you will contribute to the architecture and deployment of software solutions that support specific customer missions for on-orbit spacecraft operations and mission management. Contribute to software solutions that are deployed to customers.
Contribute to development of on-orbit software capabilities to enable delivery of end-to-end mission systems.
Integrate with legacy systems to unlock 21st-century capabilities.
Write code to improve products and scale the mission capability to different users and customers.
Collaborate across multiple teams to plan, build, and test complex functionality.

Triage issues, root cause failures, and coordinate next-steps.

Able to start full time in 2026.

Proficiency in a variety of programming languages such as C++, Go, Rust, and Python..
A desire to work on software and applications that have real-world impact.

Have a bias for action. If you see a problem, you want to solve and fix it.
Be naturally curious about the technologies and tools you use.

Preferred Qualifications

Have a bias for action. If you see a problem, you want to solve and fix it..
Be naturally curious about the technologies and tools you use..
Low-ego, high ownership, and mission oriented.

Experience with deployment tooling like Kubernetes, OpenShift, or Helm.

$132,000—$149,000 USD

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Experience with C++, Rust, Python, or another programming language, through coursework, projects, research, or prior internships

Kirkland, WA

Full-time
Onsite

About Skyband

GPS jamming and spoofing affect thousands of flights every day (GPSThreatMap.com). Skyband Systems has built the M100, a certified avionics system to overcome this threat to safety and operational reliability. The M100 fuses satellite signals from Low Earth Orbit (LEO) with inertial sensing to give pilots a trusted position source that doesn't depend on GPS.

We're a VC-backed, fast-paced team based in Kirkland, WA, made up of engineers who built and scaled Starlink Aviation at SpaceX. We design, build, test, and fly our own hardware in our own aircraft. Everyone on the team has significant ownership over product areas or problem spaces.

The Role

You'll be hands-on with the software team as the M100 goes from first production units through qualification, certification, and aircraft installation. You'll work directly with senior engineers who will give you real ownership and expect real results. By the end of your internship, you should expect that software you worked on will be test flown and used on commercial aircraft.

What You'll Do

Write, test, and ship production software for the M100 and the systems used to develop, test, and operate it
Develop embedded and real-time software for sensor processing, system health, navigation, and aircraft interfaces
Build simulators, replay tools, and data-analysis software that turn lab and flight data into engineering decisions
Expand automated unit, integration, and hardware-in-the-loop testing, including fault injection and control of real hardware
Debug problems across software, Linux, networks, electronics, test equipment, and aircraft installations
Improve build, CI, release, and observability tooling so software changes are repeatable and traceable
Support system qualification and flight test, and document designs and results to the standard certification requires

Basic Qualifications

Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s program in computer science, computer engineering, mathematics, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field
3+ months of software engineering experience from internships, research, student project teams, or substantial personal projects
Comfortable writing and debugging software in at least one programming language; much of our work uses C++, Rust, and Python
Familiarity with source control, automated testing, and fundamental software engineering practices
Authorized to work in the United States

Preferred Skills and Experience

You’ve built and tested a meaningful software project outside the classroom and can explain the decisions and tradeoffs you made
Experience with modern C++, Rust and Python
Familiarity with Linux, embedded systems, concurrency, networking, or hardware interfaces
Experience with simulation, numerical methods, signal processing, estimation, or analysis of real-world sensor data
Experience building automated test systems, hardware-in-the-loop tests, or software that interacts with physical hardware
Familiarity with CI/CD, build systems, cloud infrastructure, telemetry, or production observability
Interest in aviation, navigation, GNSS, inertial sensing, or safety-critical systems
Clear written communication and the discipline to document assumptions, tests, results, and unresolved problems

Additional Requirements

Full-time, onsite in Kirkland, WA for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks beginning June-July 2027
Able to lift up to 25 lbs. and work in lab and hangar environments
Occasional travel for aircraft integration and flight test may be required

Compensation and Benefits

$50.00/hour
$2500 relocation bonus
Paid holidays based on company holiday schedule
Direct mentorship from engineers who have shipped flight software at scale

jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI/ML) Intern
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Measurement, Analytics and Control (MACH) division is KLA’s software powerhouse, responsible for developing high-performance software platforms that support semiconductor manufacturing. MACH delivers cutting-edge technologies in patterning analytics, modeling, and data science—empowering chipmakers to ramp next-gen devices faster and more efficiently. Our cross-functional team of research scientists, software engineers, apps engineers and process engineers are solving the industry’s most complex technical problems.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

Software Engineer (AI/ML) intern may work on a variety of tasks including platform for large scale software system, data management, machine learning model training and inference solutions for KLA products.

Strong analytical capabilities and problems solving skills are crucial. Familiarity with Machine Learning and Deep Learning solutions would be a big plus.

Successful candidates are passionate about software and will have exceptional skills and hands on experience with development in Python, C++, C# or Java. Deep conceptual understanding of multi-threaded and multi process software systems is also necessary.

In addition to the above fundamental software skills, any of the following technical hands-on skills are highly desirable.

Data Structures and algorithms
Traditional machine learning using Random Forest, XG Boost, Logistic Regression.
Deep Learning for regression, classification and Generative models.
TensorFlow or Pytorch, NumPy, scikit-learn, and other ML and DL frameworks.
Distributed systems for data management.
Distributed computing infrastructure.
Cloud technologies for storage, containerization and compute clusters.
GPU architectures and data management.

Successful candidates for this position will also demonstrate the following non-technical skills.

Capability to formulate creative solutions through analyzing complex data
Good communication skills
Strong team player and motivated by team success
Strong problem-solving skills

Minimum Qualifications

Masters level degree student or a PhD candidate

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

Data Engineer

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to join our Data team and enable reliable, governed, and high-performing data products on the Army enterprise data platforms. This role plays a crucial part in improving decision-making, readiness visibility, and reporting across Army missions by focusing on data ingestion, transformation, cleaning, quality checks, lineage, and production operations of data while maintaining compliance with platform governance and DoD security requirements.

As the Data Engineer, you will build and operate data pipelines for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data sources. You'll be cleaning and preparing raw data to ensure accuracy and consistency, followed by applying transformations such as normalization, joins, and incremental loads to create reliable and optimized datasets for downstream analytics and reporting.

The role also requires implementing robust systems for data-quality checks, lineage capture, and monitoring, while troubleshooting pipeline failures through root-cause analysis. You will create and maintain incident response runbooks and optimize routine operations. The position will also involve analyzing and adhering to governance practices, such as permissions management, encryption protocols, and audit logging, ensuring compliance with DoD policies and standards.

Collaboration will be essential, as you will translate mission requirements into technical solutions, develop design documentation for platform adoption, and partner with stakeholders to uphold data quality and governance standards. Using Army data tools, including Pipeline Builder, Code Repositories, Workshop, Slate, and Machinery, you’ll deliver robust, scalable data products that drive Army readiness and success.

Join us. The world can't wait.

2+ years of experience in data engineering or database management
Experience in developing scalable ETL and ELT workflows for analytics and reporting
Experience in Vantage or Foundry components, including Pipeline Builder, Code Repositories, Workshop, Slate, and Machinery

Experience in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++

Master’s degree

Job Description

Do you enjoy getting to the bottom of a packet that never arrived?

Are you passionate about software-defined networking, secure connectivity, and making large-scale cloud infrastructure safe to change?

Join our Site Reliability team

The Cloud Networking SRE team designs, deploys, and maintains the applications and infrastructure behind Akamai Cloud's networking products. Our VPC and Cloud Firewall stack gives customers isolated private networks, stateful traffic filtering, and secure site-to-site and multi-cloud connectivity.

Help us shape the future of the Internet

In this role, you will own day-to-day reliability of our private networking, firewall, and IPSec Gateway services. You'll work with software engineering, product, and operations teams to ship dataplane and control-plane changes safely across a global fleet. You will run release rollouts, automate operational toil, build monitoring, and troubleshoot customer-impacting networking issues down to the packet. You will use open-source tools alongside internal Akamai tooling.

As a Site Reliability Engineer II, you will be responsible for:

Planning and executing phased rollouts of VPC and Cloud Firewall dataplane binaries and feature-flag enablements
Operating and troubleshooting private networking (subnets, routing, overlay/encapsulation) and stateful firewall rule enforcement on Linux hosts.
Supporting operation and readiness of the IPSec Gateway and Multi-Cloud Networking services, including tunnel health, IKE/IPsec negotiation issues, and cross-cloud connectivity.
Automating rollout steps, health checks, and recurring operational tasks using Python, Shell, and SaltStack.
Building and maintaining Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, alerts, and runbooks; support and improve SLOs for VPC, Cloud Firewall, and IPSec Gateway.
Joining on-call and incident triage for networking issues, drive mitigation to reduce MTTR, and contribute to post-mortem reviews and follow-up actions.
Contributing to Technical Readiness Reviews (TRRs) for new features, and keep SOPs and team knowledge bases current.

Do What You Love

To be successful in this role you will:

Have 2 years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or its equivalent
Have an understanding of core networking: TCP/IP, subnetting, L2/L3 routing, NAT, DNS, and stateful firewalling.
Possess hands-on Linux networking experience: network namespaces, bridges, virtual interfaces, iptables/nftables, and connection tracking (conntrack).
Possess packet-level troubleshooting skills with tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark/tshark, ip, ss, traceroute, and mtr.
Have experience writing automation in Python or Shell, and with configuration management (SaltStack or Ansible) and CI/CD (Jenkins).
Have experience with Prometheus and Grafana for metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
Have a clear understanding of deployment safety: phased rollouts, canaries, feature flags, validation, and rollback.

The Automation Engineer

This role partners with business analysts, subject matter experts, and technology teams to understand business requirements and determine the most appropriate automation approach, such as APIs, system integrations, workflow automation, RPA, data pipelines, or native application capabilities. Design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable automation solutions across enterprise applications and business processes, managing each solution throughout its lifecycle, including enhancements, dependencies, technical debt, platform upgrades, and retirement.
Assess automation opportunities identified by product owners, subject matter experts, and business partners, providing technical feasibility, level of effort, and risk input to support prioritization decisions.

Position Summary

Caris Life Sciences serves hundreds of thousands of molecular cases a year and continues to grow at double-digit rates. Its molecular, imaging, and clinical-outcomes data support software that helps ensure a cancer patient's report is right, complete, and on time.

The Software Engineer, Clinical Software Products contributes engineering work across Caris's clinical application portfolio: product delivery, reliability, and incremental modernization of the production systems that support regulated clinical workflows.

This assignment supports the case-management and order-intake platform: the order front door and case-lifecycle services every case runs through on its way to a report. The engineering environment supports advanced AI coding assistants and agentic workflows across design, implementation, and test generation. Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Hands-on experience across the full SDLC in a team setting: requirements refinement, design, implementation, testing, and release.

About ITradeNetwork

At iTradeNetwork, we provide advanced supply chain software and insights tailored to the food & beverage industry. Our mission is clear and ambitious: To feed the world.
From the start, we’ve been dedicated to tackling the most pressing challenges within food and beverage supply chains, delivering innovative solutions and expert support that make a measurable impact.

Our cutting-edge technology helps businesses streamline complex procurement and fulfillment processes, minimize food waste, optimize inventory, manage compliance risk, and scale profitably. We’re proud to serve an elite customer base, including 13 of the top 25 North American grocers, 8 of the top 10 foodservice distributors, and 8 of the top 10 global food and beverage manufacturers.

Today, we're building an AI-first company — meaning AI isn't a feature we bolt on, it's the foundation for how we design products, make decisions, and ship software. Cerena is proof of that in action: powered by the most connected supply chain network in food and beverage, iTradeNetwork's Solution Suite replaces error-prone manual workflows with faster, smarter tools — driving real results for our customers, and ultimately, for the consumers who depend on them.

iTradeNetwork's Leadership Principles

iTradeNetwork’s purpose is to feed the world — and everything we do is guided by the principles below. Every team member is expected to embody and champion these principles across the organization.

Bias for Action

We value speed and avoid analysis paralysis. We develop conviction, make informed decisions quickly, and take calculated risks to maintain momentum — knowing that swift progress is essential for innovation and growth.

Customer Obsession

We work relentlessly to delight our customers. We work backward from their needs to solve pain points and create solutions that surprise and earn their loyalty. We obsess over customers, not competitors.

Data & Metrics Driven

We operate with facts, not opinions. We dive deep into data and use metrics to measure progress, ground every decision in rigorous analysis, and push for clarity and measurable outcomes.

Raise the Bar

We continuously push for improvement — in ourselves, our teams, and the company. We hire and develop exceptional talent, setting ever-higher standards that elevate performance and drive excellence.

Operational Excellence Through Process

We build lasting processes that optimize for efficiency. By developing, testing, and documenting each process, we create consistency and scale through automation, enabling continuous improvement across the business.

Ownership Mindset

We take responsibility for our work and aim for long-term success. We use resources wisely, stay accountable, and roll up our sleeves to get things done — no task is beneath us.

Earn Trust

We build trust through integrity, transparency, and mutual respect. We communicate openly, own our mistakes, listen actively, and remain open to feedback as an opportunity for growth.

Job Summary

We are building an AI-first company — which means AI isn’t a feature we bolt on; it’s the foundation of how we design products, make decisions, and ship software. As an AI/ML Software Engineer, you’ll be on the front lines of that mission: building intelligent, production-ready applications that put machine learning at the core of the user experience.

This is a role for someone who has built a solid foundation and is ready to take on more. You’ll deliver well-scoped features and services with increasing independence, partner with senior engineers and data scientists on larger initiatives, and deepen your expertise at the intersection of AI/ML and full stack development — all in service of one of the most consequential industries in the world.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and ship AI-powered full stack features — from model integration to user-facing interfaces — using modern frameworks and cloud-native infrastructure, with growing independence on well-scoped work.
Partner with data scientists to productionize ML models: wrapping them in APIs, implementing and tuning inference pipelines, and monitoring performance and reliability in live environments.
Build and maintain data pipelines that support model training, validation, and deployment workflows, including data quality checks and basic observability.
Develop frontend experiences (React or similar) that surface AI-driven insights in intuitive, responsive interfaces.
Develop and maintain backend services and microservices that power model serving, data ingestion, and business logic — writing well-tested, documented code and helping troubleshoot and resolve production issues.
Participate in code reviews and collaborative design discussions — giving constructive feedback to peers, incorporating feedback from senior engineers, and contributing your own perspective.
Stay current with the AI/ML landscape and bring practical ideas back to the team — new tooling, frameworks, and LLM techniques — through small evaluations, prototypes, or demos.

Required

What you’ll need:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
2–3 years of professional software engineering experience, including shipping and maintaining production code, ideally on AI/ML-enabled or data-intensive applications.
Solid working knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and software design fundamentals, applied to write clean, testable code.
Working knowledge of core AI/ML concepts: supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, model evaluation, and how models are deployed and served in production.
Proficiency in Python (strongly preferred given its centrality to the ML ecosystem) or another backend language, with experience building and maintaining APIs and services.
Hands-on professional experience with web development (React, Angular, or comparable framework) building user-facing features.
Working experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases, including schema design and query optimization.
A problem-solving mindset and genuine curiosity about how AI can change the way software works.

Nice To Have

Hands-on experience with Python ML libraries: TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and deploying ML workloads in the cloud.
Experience integrating LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns into applications.
Working knowledge of MLOps tooling: experiment tracking, model registries, CI/CD for ML pipelines.
Experience taking an AI/ML application from prototype to production, whether in a professional setting or through significant project work.

Who You Are

You think AI-first — when approaching a problem, your instinct is to ask how intelligence can be built into the solution, not added as an afterthought (Raise the Bar)
You move fast and learn faster. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the pace of change in the AI space (Bias for Action)
You take ownership. You don’t wait to be told what to do next; you find the next important thing and work on it (Ownership Mindset)
You care about craft — clean code, thoughtful documentation, and systems that are built to last. (Customer Obsession)

Qualtrics is seeking a Software Engineer II to join our XM Directory (XMD) Engineering team in our Seattle office. If you have a Bachelor’s degree, have 2+ years of software engineering experience, and want to work at a fast-growing tech company, Qualtrics could be the place you’ve been dreaming about.

You should love building simple solutions to solve hard customer problems and designing systems in an agile environment to withstand hyper growth.

How You’ll Find Success

Ability to create trust in customers and teams through thorough communication
Strong level of curiosity
Takes initiative and shows scrappiness in getting things done, and asks for help early when blocked
Proven ability to work well in teams - partnering with managers, cross-functional teams, and teammates
Takes an analytical mindset to approach problems and find solutions
Shows a desire to learn new skills and grow in the role

How You’ll Grow

Deepen your skills in building scalable, fast, robust, and simple SaaS solutions
Expand your experience with distributed systems, containerization, and databases
Grow from owning components to contributing to larger technical designs
Learn from senior engineers, tech-ops, and product managers
Take on mentoring opportunities with new teammates and interns

Things You’ll Do

Build scalable, reliable backend services and web interfaces to solve customer problems
Implement new features and optimize existing ones to improve performance
Own well-scoped features and components, from design through delivery
Work with senior engineers to clarify requirements and contribute to technical designs
Use AI-assisted tools to move faster, and take responsibility for the correctness, security, and performance of what you ship
Write well-tested code, and give and receive feedback in code reviews
Work with product, design, and other XMD teams, and join daily stand-ups to deliver value to customers
Share what you learn and help improve engineering practices on your team

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
2+ years working in a software engineering position (full-stack or backend)
Solid algorithms, data structures, and coding fundamentals
Has worked with design and product teams to understand needs and turn them into end-user features
Has contributed to scalable, fast, robust web-based solutions that solve complex business problems
Exposure to web infrastructure and distributed systems
Experience with continuous delivery, git, test automation, and build/deploy systems

What You Should Know About This Team

Every great experience starts with knowing who you’re talking to. XM Directory is where that knowledge lives. When a customer, employee, or other stakeholder interacts with a company, XM Directory can capture it and remember it. Over time, those moments add up to living profiles that show what people like, what they need, and how every interaction makes them feel. That experience context helps close the Experience Gap, the distance between what people expect and what companies deliver, and it lets AI, including our Experience Agents, act in the moments that matter. As Qualtrics builds its next-generation XM Data & AI Platform, you’ll work on the data layer it depends on.

Behind that is an engineering team solving big-data problems: storage systems built to hold stakeholder data at scale, and computation and serving layers that make it fast and useful the moment someone needs it. When AI is acting inside a live customer moment, that data has to be fresh, accurate, and fast to reach. We pick the right tool for each job from a broad toolkit of open source and industry-proven technologies, including Elasticsearch, AWS DynamoDB, AWS Kinesis, Redis, and more.

As a Software Engineer II on the XMD team, you’ll apply your engineering experience to meaningful problems in distributed systems and data infrastructure, collaborate closely with senior engineers, and help build the data foundation that AI-powered experiences depend on.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks And Benefits

We spend 10% of our time on individual engineering growth activities every quarter
We participate in personalized Career Action Planning. You will work with your manager to design a plan based on your life experiences, values, and career aspirations (inside and outside Qualtrics) that helps you achieve your career goals at Qualtrics
Variable allowances for wellness, meals, transportation, and more.

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model:
Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid

Welcome to Financial Engineering
— where advanced financial models become high-impact software solutions. Our team builds the systems that generate many of the critical numbers used to drive business decisions across the enterprise. jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Nicolet National Bank, our culture is based on the principles of community banking, putting the needs of our customers at the forefront of our decision-making. Our Core Values drive everything we do, and we are committed to serving our customers with excellence. We believe that every job in our organization is critical to our success, and we are dedicated to creating a work environment where our employees feel valued, respected, and supported. With locations in Wisconsin, Michigan, Minnesota, Iowa, and Florida we are proud to service our local communities and make a positive impact on the lives of our customers. At Nicolet National Bank, we believe that our people are our most valuable asset, and we are committed to investing in their growth and development.

The Automation Engineer
is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and supporting scalable automation solutions that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and improve business processes across Nicolet.

This role partners with business analysts, subject matter experts, and technology teams to understand business requirements and determine the most appropriate automation approach, such as APIs, system integrations, workflow automation, RPA, data pipelines, or native application capabilities. The Automation Engineer applies sound engineering practices to translate validated requirements into well-designed, supportable, and secure automation solutions.

As An Automation Engineer, You Will

Design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable automation solutions across enterprise applications and business processes, managing each solution throughout its lifecycle, including enhancements, dependencies, technical debt, platform upgrades, and retirement.
Assess automation opportunities identified by product owners, subject matter experts, and business partners, providing technical feasibility, level of effort, and risk input to support prioritization decisions.
Partner with product owners and subject matter experts to review and clarify business requirements, confirm process and data details, and validate that proposed automation designs meet business needs before development begins.
Evaluate solution alternatives including APIs, integrations, workflow automation, RPA, and native system capabilities to select maintainable and scalable approaches.
Integrate automations with enterprise applications and data platforms using APIs, SQL, Snowflake, Alteryx, and other appropriate technologies.
Establish and maintain automation engineering standards covering architecture, source control, documentation, testing, peer review, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management in coordination with the Nicolet development team.
Monitor production automations, troubleshoot failures, manage exceptions, perform root cause analysis, and improve reliability and performance.
Develop reusable automation components, integrations, frameworks, and design patterns to improve consistency and accelerate delivery.
Ensure automations adhere to information security, access management, data protection, audit, change management, business continuity, and regulatory requirements.
Partner with application, infrastructure, security, data, and support teams to ensure solutions are documented and can be effectively supported.
Evaluate emerging automation capabilities and recommend opportunities to improve the bank's automation platform and engineering practices.
Uphold Nicolet’s philosophy and policies by maintaining appropriate controls to ensure full compliance with applicable laws and regulations, thereby fulfilling legal responsibilities and enhancing the quality of services provided by Nicolet.
Understand and communicate the value of diversity within the workplace and to work successfully with others without regard to age, gender, race, sexual orientation, ethnicity, culture, religion, disability status, socioeconomic status or other non-job-related classification, including a commitment to Nicolet’s policies on equal employment opportunities and non-discrimination with a willingness to pursue efforts of inclusion and respect toward different perspectives.
Performs all other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position is initially an individual contributor role with the potential to evolve into technical leadership or direct supervisory responsibility as Nicolet's automation program grows.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
4+ years of experience developing and supporting enterprise automation, RPA, workflow or integration solutions.
Hands-on experience with automation platforms such as UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate.
Experience establishing automation development, quality assurance, or governance standards preferred.
Financial services or other regulated-industry experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process-design skills, including the ability to translate business requirements into sound automation designs.
Proficiency with enterprise automation technologies, preferably UiPath and/or Microsoft Power Automate.
Experience integrating automation solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and data platforms.
Working knowledge of SQL and data integration concepts, with exposure to data platforms.
Understanding of SDLC, source control, CI/CD, automated testing, and release management practices.
Understanding of automation architecture, exception handling, monitoring, logging, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to elicit and clarify requirements from subject matter experts and to explain technical options to non-technical audiences.
Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive information.

Benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life Insurance
401(k) with a company match
PTO & 11 1/2 Paid Holidays

About the Team

The Autonomous Vehicle Microcontrollers team develops embedded platform software that provides the foundation for AV systems. Our software communicates with sensors, supports vehicle operation, provides observability, manages system health, and enables reliable operation of vehicle and platform functions.

About The Role

As a Software Engineer on the AV MCU Platform team, you will independently own moderate-scope software features, components, or sub-projects related to MCU01. You will contribute across the development lifecycle‚ from requirements and design through implementation, integration, testing, debugging, documentation, and release support. You will work closely with systems, hardware, safety, cybersecurity, integration, and validation teams to deliver production-quality embedded software.

Come build the future of self-driving at GM.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)

Reproduce and diagnose software failures using logs, traces, debugger data, telemetry, test evidence, and controlled experiments.
Perform structured root-cause analysis for crashes, memory faults, timing issues, race conditions, communication failures, watchdog resets, and unexpected state transitions as applicable.
Design, develop, integrate, and maintain embedded C software for multi-core microcontrollers.
Implement moderate-scope features, enhancements, integrations, and defect fixes within the assigned software component or subsystem.
Develop across the applicable automotive embedded software stack, including BSP, BSW, middleware, RTOS services, drivers, and application software.
Write maintainable, modular, efficient, and testable code consistent with team coding standards.
Implement robust handling for initialization, state transitions, communication errors, diagnostics, degraded operation, watchdog events, and fault recovery as applicable.
Analyze the impact of software changes on interfaces, timing, memory, CPU utilization, configuration, and dependent components.

Bachelors degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related STEM field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

2+ years of experience building and shipping production quality embedded software
Background in C Embedded Software development
Understanding software development lifecycle practices, source control, code reviews, continuous integration, and issue tracking.
Experience working with RTOS (such as QNX, FreeRTOS, OSEK, etc.)
Good communication skills, capable of switching between high-level and detailed discussions

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have)

Experience with robotics, autonomous vehicles, automotive embedded systems, or ADAS development
Experience working with AUTOSAR
Experience working in a Safety Critical Embedded Software Environment (ISO 26262, DO-178C, MIL-STD-882E)
Experience with JIRA, DOORs NG, Confluence, Github, Lauterbach, Visual Studio Code.
Experience developing software that scales to millions of instances and managing it
Ability to adapt and operate under ambiguity, going from quick code prototypes to long-term plans on brief time horizons
2+ years of experience building and shipping production quality embedded software
Masters degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related STEM field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

About US Air Tech

US Air Tech Corporation – USAT is developing advanced UAS (Unmanned Aerial Systems – drones), AI-driven robotic controls, navigation, and communication technologies through its STELLA® platform. The company’s technology roadmap includes compact electronic systems for UAS, satellite communication payloads, high-frequency antenna systems, ultra-sensitive receivers, and integrated communication architectures for LEO satellite networks, IoT connectivity, defense communication, and space-air-ground applications.

Position Summary

USAT is seeking a Software Engineer to design, develop, integrate, and test software for our UAS platforms and RF/communications payloads. The work spans flight-control and navigation software, AI-driven autonomy and robotic control, antenna and modem control, and embedded software for FPGA, ASIC, and microcontroller-based hardware. The ideal candidate combines strong programming skills with hands-on experience in UAS, navigation, or embedded communications systems, and works closely with RF, FPGA, ASIC, electrical, mechanical, and systems engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and integrate flight-control, navigation, and autonomy software using UAS open-source stacks (e.g., PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, ROS 2).
Develop software for communication protocols, telemetry, command/control, data acquisition, hardware interfaces, system monitoring, and engineering test workflows.
Support UAS-related software workflows such as satellite tracking support, pass prediction integration, link monitoring, modem control, Doppler compensation support, antenna pointing support, and communication status reporting.
Develop embedded and application-level software for FPGA-connected, ASIC-connected, microprocessor-based, and microcontroller-based communication systems.
Implement software interfaces for RF front ends, modems, SDR platforms, ADC/DAC systems, antenna control units, power systems, sensors, and test equipment over interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, and Ethernet.
Build software-in-the-loop (SIL) and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation, automated test frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines for prototype and product software.
Support lab and field flight testing: collect and analyze logs, troubleshoot integration issues, and feed results back into design.
Develop clear technical documentation, software architecture diagrams, interface control documents, test procedures, user guides, and release notes.
Support software version control, build management, code reviews, issue tracking, and release readiness for prototype and product software.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field.
3+ years of professional experience in software engineering for UAS, robotics, embedded systems, communication systems, or hardware-control software.
Strong programming experience in C or C++ and Python; experience with Rust, Go, Java, or MATLAB is a plus.
Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: a UAS autopilot stack (PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink), ROS/ROS 2, embedded firmware development, or SDR/RF hardware-control software.
Proficiency with Git, code review, and issue tracking; strong software architecture, documentation, and cross-functional communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Embedded Linux and RTOS experience (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and real-time constraints.
Experience with SIL/HIL simulation, test automation, and CI/CD.

Work Environment, Security, and Compliance

On-site work in Tucson, AZ, including lab work and field testing.
U.S. citizenship is required.

Startup Environment and Expectations

USAT operates as a fast-moving startup focused on advanced UAS, RF, and antenna system development. Candidates should be prepared for an intense, hands-on engineering environment where priorities can move quickly, technical challenges are demanding, and individual ownership matters. Engineers are expected to be willing to contribute across design, testing, prototyping, troubleshooting, and documentation as needed.

What Success Looks Like

This role is expected to quickly become a key contributor to US Air Tech’s software capability, helping convert UAS and RF system requirements into reliable, testable, and field-ready software. In the first 1-2 months, candidate will learn the STELLA® software architecture, toolchain, and target hardware; land their first reviewed contribution and add automated tests. Subsequently, they will own a defined component, such as a hardware driver, protocol implementation, or antenna-control module, with a documented interface and tests.

Compensation and Benefits

Final compensation will be based on experience, education, and demonstrated software engineering, communication systems, UAS, embedded software, and hardware-integration expertise.

Equal Opportunity Statement

USAT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from diverse software engineering, computer science, computer engineering, and communication systems backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive engineering team focused on next-generation UAS, RF systems, and field-deployable communication technologies.

How to Apply

Send your resume to contact@usairtechcorp.com with the subject line “Software Engineer – [Your Name].” In your resume or cover note, highlight your experience with UAS, navigation, and embedded or RF software, and confirm that you are a U.S. citizen.

Summary

We are seeking a Full Stack Software Developer to design, build, and own the internal software systems that power our manufacturing operations. This is a high-autonomy role spanning the entire stack; from front-end dashboards and back-end services to equipment-level communication protocols where you will drive architecture decisions and deliver end-to-end solutions across MES/RMS integrations, production monitoring tools, and SECS/GEM host software. You will join a team of approximately ten engineers within the MIS department, working alongside MES, database, and systems engineering colleagues in an open office environment with occasional time in cleanroom manufacturing areas. As AOI scales U.S. production capacity to meet accelerating AI datacenter demand, this role will be central to building the software infrastructure that supports higher throughput, better yield and yield visibility, with more reliable equipment automation.

Responsibilities

Internal Web Application Development
Design, develop, own, and maintain full-stack web applications for internal manufacturing operations, including production dashboards, equipment monitoring portals, and operational tools.
Build responsive front-end interfaces and robust back-end services using C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core, Blazor) as the primary stack, with JavaScript/TypeScript as a secondary development stack.
Implement scalable and maintainable software architectures that serve multiple teams across manufacturing, process engineering, quality, and operations.
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code that adheres to best practices and coding standards.

Maintain and enhance EAP (Equipment Automation Program) software that enables communication between manufacturing equipment and factory systems.
Configure and maintain SECS/GEM communication in compliance with SEMI standards (e.g., SECS-I, HSMS, GEM), including equipment messaging, event reporting, alarms, status variables, and remote command execution.

will design and implement advanced analytical models to extract insights from static images and video within the manufacturing environment. This role focuses on object measurement, classification, anomaly detection, and leveraging these insights to build predictive and recommendation algorithms that deliver measurable business value. The developer will also articulate benefits to stakeholders, ensuring adoption and prioritization of operationalization.

Edge Deployment & Factory Integration: Optimize and deploy trained models onto edge devices (e.g. NVIDIA Jetson, industrial PCs, PLCs, smart cameras) in the manufacturing environment, in collaboration with control system team.
Cloud & Server Integration for Real-Time Analysis: Leverage cloud infrastructure (e.g. Azure Foundry, DevOps, GitHub, Fabric) as appropriate for model training, deployment, governance, and downstream data availability.
Partner with manufacturing and process engineering teams to ensure models address real-world operational needs and drive the operationalization of developed models into production workflows and communicate value.
Report and monitor model performance using BI tools (Spotfire / Power BI) and communicate actionable insights. Develop and implement optimization and maintenance plans for validation and retraining of models as appropriate.

Additional Responsibilities

Collaborate with Data & Analytics team members to drive excellence in data science model building, model management, and deployment.
Work with procurement and external suppliers to leverage external expertise in key technologies or integration capabilities
Support data science and enterprise reporting initiatives within the wider analytics ecosystem.
Support Data & Analytics team initiatives around governance, data quality & management, and Community of Practice.
Stay informed of new and planned improvements in data management, visualization, modeling, visual analysis, and integration technologies across the industry and communicate their potential value/impact to our analytics practice.
Communicate business value to business users and leaders through identification of opportunities to explore and apply machine vision analytics in new ways.

Skills

Strong proficiency in computer vision techniques (OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Knowledge of Machine Vision systems and related hardware (cameras, optics, lighting, IOT, networking, etc)
Expertise in image/video processing, including but not limited to feature extraction, classification, edge finding, and morphology.
Solid understanding of predictive modeling techniques and model governance.
Programming skills in Python, C++/C#, or similar and familiarity with visual analytics libraries and code and task management (GitHub, DevOps).
Ability to build user-friendly interfaces utilizing storytelling techniques.
Ability to communicate technical concepts in business terms and influence decision-making.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking, with an emphasis on product development.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams

Preferred Skills

Advanced Power BI, Spotfire, or similar BI tool development and dashboarding experience is preferred
Experience with a wide array of camera, lighting, IOT integration, and edge computing solutions.
Experience with manufacturing or industrial environmental requirements affecting hardware selection
Familiarity with SCADA systems, with strong preference for Ignition.
Experience in industrial metrology, product quality, and/or chemical manufacturing
Familiarity with business reporting and common business KPIs
Statistical modeling and advanced analysis techniques
Builds collaborative relationships
Ability to influence through Storytelling

Education

BS, MS, or PhD in computer science, data science, engineering (with software focus), or closely related field (Master’s or above preferred).

Required Work Experience

Curiosity and a willingness to explore (and fail)
3-5 years of experience in computer vision, image analytics, or related fields, with at least 2 years within a manufacturing context
Proven track record of deploying models in production environments
Working knowledge of Spotfire Analytics, Power BI or similar data visualization tool
A high level of initiative and bias for action
