jobs.description:
About Swoop:

Swoop Technologies has a mission to organize and make accessible the world’s military and critical infrastructure. We are building a distributed operating system, SwoopOS, that decomposes the world’s equipment into a distributed robotic embodiment upon which a new generation of distributed systems, autonomous systems, and agentic AI can be built and deployed using our SDK, Valhalla, and operated via our browser, Surf. Imagine the world’s equipment - consisting of the electrical grid, communications architectures, manufacturing facilities, and militaries as a trapped supply of inputs possessing the potential to ensure Western military advantage, sovereign control of economically competitive manufacturing capacity, or the creation of a grid that fosters energy dominance. Swoop is liberating these trapped assets, allowing them to contribute to the world’s future as a series of building blocks to be combined at the speed of software, limited by only the hard constraints of physics and the soft constraints of safety. That is what Swoop is building. Not in the data center or cloud or edge on-premise computing node. In the physical world. This is a hybrid position that requires someone based in Minneapolis/St. Paul OR Washington, DC who can work in-office 3+ days per week

Impact:

Swoop’s operating system challenges many paradigms defining a scalable API. Management, security, and interoperability each will be re-imagined in how Swoop’s OS exposes interfaces to inputs and outputs within the stack. You will have a role developing APIs that Swoop developers leverage to build user-facing applications running on the Swoop platform. These APIs will be further leveraged and exposed to 3rd parties to develop an ecosystem of novel applications running on the Swoop OS.

What You’ll Do:

Develop and build new services and features, working closely internally with our firmware team to interface with the SwoopOS, our frontend team to support our web application, and our infrastructure team to deliver a stable product to market.
Design and build SDK’s for internal and external use, working with 3rd parties as they develop applications to run on our OS.
Author new Python packages for common functionality used across multiple services.
Ensure our services have strong availability and service level agreements across our code base, especially as it pertains to the runtime of our Kubernetes cluster in production.
Tune data storage configurations to optimize for scale and near real-time availability in a streaming architecture.

You Should Have:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent technical experience
3+ yrs in backend software development writing scalable code and/or modern APIs structured from databases and distributed data sources
Proficient Python coding ability with good understanding of data structures and data models
Experience with Kubernetes in a production environment
Understanding of basic software security standards
Active US Security clearance or ability and willingness to be sponsored for a US Security clearance
Travel Requirement - 5-20%

Bonus if you have:

Experience with one or more of the following: async Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Solr, Rust
Experience handling multimedia data structures

jobs.description:
Position Introduction/Key Duties

Cimarron is seeking a Platform Engineer
to help build, operate, and modernize the OpenShift and Kubernetes platform that hosts next-generation mission applications. In this role, you will containerize and deploy mission software, modernize CI/CD pipelines, support telemetry and machine learning workloads, and work alongside experienced NASA platform engineers to enhance platform capabilities through automation, documentation, and operational excellence.

You will design, implement, and maintain GitOps-driven deployment workflows and infrastructure automation practices, while supporting platform reliability through proactive monitoring, observability, performance tuning, incident response, and root-cause analysis. The position also includes developing and maintaining dashboards, logging, metrics, alerting, and operational reporting capabilities to ensure a secure, scalable, and resilient platform environment.

Your work will directly support the software, data, and infrastructure technologies that enable NASA flight controllers, engineers, and mission support personnel to monitor, analyze, and operate human spaceflight missions and future exploration systems.

This is a hybrid position based at NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston, TX.

Key Duties

Containerize, package and deploy mission applications (on-premises and cloud) on an OpenShift/Kubernetes cluster, applying best practices for container security, dependency management, resource planning and lifecycle operations.
Design, build and refine automated CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI, including pipeline modernization, reproducible artifacts and a multi-tenant runner strategy aligned with GitOps and DevSecOps practices.
Work alongside senior NASA platform engineers to share day-to-day cluster operations, upgrades and troubleshooting.
Write runbooks, architecture and configuration documentation, and infrastructure-as-code so the platform can be operated reliably by more than one person.
Deploy and operate the MQTT telemetry bridge and its supporting services and provide GPU and model-serving capacity for machine learning engineers.
Contribute designs for modular, scalable, loosely coupled architectures and prototypes for future missions with other NASA organizations.
Provide OpenShift, Kubernetes and containerization expertise to NASA teams, and follow NASA and JSC standards for software development and IT security.

Required/Desired Skills, Experience, And Education

Required Skills, Experience, and Education:

Due to facility security requirements, only U.S. citizens are eligible for consideration at this time.
Ability to complete a pre-employment background check and drug screening, which will include but is not limited to testing for marijuana use.
3 or more years of software or systems engineering experience, including 2 or more years of DevOps or platform engineering and 1 or more years operating Red Hat OpenShift or Kubernetes in production.
Hands-on experience deploying, upgrading and troubleshooting OpenShift/Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
Experience building GitLab CI pipelines and operating GitLab Runners.
Scripting and infrastructure-as-code skills (for example Ansible, Helm, Kustomize, Terraform) and Linux administration.
Working knowledge of container security and DevSecOps practices.
A collaborative style: you document what you build and enjoy working with, and learn from, more senior engineers.
Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.

Desired Skills, Experience And Education

Red Hat certifications (EX280/EX288) or CKA/CKAD.
Experience with GitOps tooling such as Argo CD, bare metal OpenShift builds and GPU workloads on OpenShift.
Experience with hybrid on-premises and cloud infrastructure.
Keycloak or other identity provider experience.
Prior NASA, federal or other mission-critical systems experience.

jobs.title: Sr. Front-End/Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Sr. Front-End/Full Stack Developer

What does a successful Sr. Front-End/Fullstack Engineer do at Clover?

In this role, you will be a lead UI/UX-minded engineer responsible for driving the client-side evolution and expansion of our platform. While you have the full-stack capability to navigate backend APIs, your primary strength and passion lie in building exceptional web experiences, modern user interfaces, and modular frontend architectures. As part of the Loyalty Program team, you will own the user experience on the Clover Dashboard
, translating complex data into sleek, responsive web applications used by over 700k merchants worldwide. Working alongside a strong team of dedicated backend engineers, you will bridge the gap between design, product, and services—owning web client features end-to-end, evaluating modern frontend technologies, and ensuring sub-second UI responsiveness at scale.

What You Will Do

Architect, design, and develop high-performance, modular web-based frontend applications using React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript, backed by supporting Java/Spring Boot microservices.
Own the client-side architecture of the Clover Dashboard, establishing frontend best practices, state management standards, and component libraries.
Partner with Product, UX, and core Backend Engineers to translate product requirements into intuitive, reliable web workflows and clean, extensible software.
Design, consume, and optimize RESTful APIs and GraphQL/event-driven endpoints built for web clients, mobile dashboards, and 3rd-party app integrations.
Promote effective use of AI‑powered engineering tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, automated test generation, code review, and UI performance profiling) to accelerate delivery and quality.
Own client services and features from design through deployment, automated UI testing, and production monitoring.
Participate in design and code reviews, advocating for modular code, responsive design, accessibility, and clean frontend architecture.
Coach and mentor team members to improve their technical frontend capabilities, web performance optimization, and UI testing strategies.
Participate in regular release management and cross-functional agile rituals across distributed teams.

What You Will Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of software development experience, with a proven focus on Frontend / Web Engineering.
Expertise in React and TypeScript, including deep knowledge of modern client-side state management, build tooling (Webpack/Vite), and Web Performance Optimization.
Strong Full Stack capabilities: Working knowledge of Java and Spring Boot to build, update, or integrate with existing backend microservices.
Hands-on experience with modern CSS frameworks, component design systems, and responsive web design for complex dashboard interfaces.
Experience using and championing AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, automated test suites) to accelerate UI delivery.
Practical knowledge of RESTful API design, HTTP/browser protocols, web security (OAuth2, CORS), and working with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).

What Would Be Great To Have

Experience with Micro-frontend architectures (e.g., Webpack Module Federation).
Familiarity with secondary languages/tools: Python, Node.js, GraphQL, or Docker/Kubernetes containerized workflows.
Previous background in Fintech, e-commerce, POS platforms, or merchant analytics tools.
Experience re-architecting client-side monoliths into decoupled, high-availability web applications.

How You’ll Work

This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.
This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment.

Benefits At Fiserv

Fuel Your Life program to support your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being
Paid holidays and generous time away policies
No-cost mental health support through Employee Assistance Programs
Living Proof program to recognize your peers’ extra effort with points redeemable for rewards
Eight Employee Resource Groups to foster a collaborative culture and expand your network

Unparalleled professional growth with training, development, and internal mobility opportunities
Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance options available from day one
Retirement planning and discounted shares with the Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Tuition assistance and reimbursement program
Paid parental, caregiver, and military leave

Salary Range

$140,000.00 - $210,000.00

These pay ranges apply to employees in Sunnyvale, California. Pay ranges for employees in other states may differ.

It is unlawful to discriminate against a prospective employee due to the individual's status as a veteran.

For incentive eligible associates, the successful candidate is eligible for an annual incentive opportunity which may be delivered as a mix of cash bonus and equity awards in the Company’s sole discretion.

Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please

Apply using your legal name
Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

Our Commitment To Equal Opportunity

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation in completing a job application or otherwise participating in the overall hiring process, please contact AskHR.US@fiserv.com. Please note our AskHR representatives do not have visibility to your application status. Current associates who require a workplace accommodation should refer to Fiserv’s Disability Accommodation Policy for additional information.

Note To Agencies

Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.

Warning About Fake Job Posts

Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Business Technology
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic is looking for product engineers to build internal products. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and design—you'll own outcomes, not just tasks. You'll work directly with users to understand their needs, identify the patterns behind their requests, and build the right abstractions that unlock capabilities for everyone.

What You'll Do

Rapidly design, prototype, and ship full-stack features across backend, frontend, and infrastructure
Consult with users and stakeholders to understand workflows and identify the highest-impact opportunities
Spot patterns across user requests and reduce them into primitives, platforms, or middleware that support a variety of use cases—not just one-off features
Build tools that maximize autonomy and creative freedom for less-technical users
Make product and prioritization decisions, not just execute on specs handed to you
Iterate quickly based on feedback to continuously improve the user experience
Pick up new tools, frameworks, and domains as the product evolves

You May Be a Good Fit If You

Have 6+ years of experience building production software, ideally full-stack
Can operate as a team of one when needed—you're independently capable of taking a product from idea to shipped, even if you won't always work that way
Think in systems and abstractions—you see the platform behind the feature request
Care about empowering users, not just building for them
Own outcomes, not just code—you care whether the thing you built actually solved the problem
Are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and operating with ambiguity
Hold yourself to a high bar without needing external pressure

Strong Candidates Will Have

Proficiency across the stack (we use Python, TypeScript, React)
Experience building platforms, primitives, or internal tools that others build on top of
A track record of shipping products independently—not just contributing to larger efforts

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

About The Role

We're looking for experienced software engineers to join our Beneficial Deployments Engineering team to help bring Claude to communities that need AI most—nonprofits, educational institutions, healthcare organizations, life sciences researchers, and economic mobility initiatives globally.

This role requires strong full-stack engineering skills combined with deep empathy for underserved communities and mission-driven organizations. Understand the needs of underserved communities and translate them into scalable technical and product solutions
Build flexible pricing, billing, and provisioning systems that balance accessibility with sustainability for resource-constrained organizations
Develop MCP integrations that connect Claude with mission-critical tools used by nonprofits, educators, healthcare workers, and researchers
Develop multilingual and accessibility capabilities across platforms
Build systems to measure and demonstrate social impact at scale
Partner with product, partnerships, and field teams to rapidly prototype and validate solutions with real communities
Ensure platform reliability and performance for mission-critical deployments in humanitarian and social impact contexts

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

Have 6+ years of practical experience as a full-stack software engineer
Have experience building consumer or enterprise products that prioritize accessibility, inclusivity, or served underserved populations
Have technical expertise in identity management, billing systems, self-serve onboarding flows, or API integrations
Have a builder mentality with ability to ship products quickly while maintaining quality for diverse user needs
Care deeply about using technology for social good and want your engineering work to have meaningful impact
Have excellent collaboration skills and can work effectively with product, partnerships, and field teams

Experience with international markets, multilingual products, or accessibility features
Background in nonprofit technology, social impact startups, or mission-driven organizations

Understanding of compliance requirements in regulated sectors

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I - XMD
jobs.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Software Engineer I - XMD

Why We Have This Role

Qualtrics is seeking a Software Engineer I to join our XM Directory (XMD) Engineering team in our Seattle office. If you have a Bachelor’s degree, some software engineering experience or relevant internships, and want to work at a fast-growing tech company, Qualtrics could be the place you’ve been dreaming about.

You should love building simple solutions to solve hard customer problems and designing systems in an agile environment to withstand hyper growth.

How You’ll Find Success

Ability to create trust in customers and teams through thorough communication
Strong level of curiosity
Takes initiative and shows scrappiness in getting things done, and asks for help early when blocked
Proven ability to work well in teams - partnering with managers, cross-functional teams, and teammates
Takes an analytical mindset to approach problems and find solutions
Shows a desire to learn new skills and grow in the role

How You’ll Grow

Develop the ability to build scalable, fast, robust, and simple SaaS solutions.
Learn dev tools, operational tools, test tools, and containerization.
Learn to implement functionality from well-defined technical requirements and specifications.
Benefit from working with other engineers, tech-ops, and product managers.
Learn Agile methodologies by attending daily stand-up meetings, prioritizing tasks, and working with a sense of urgency to meet a scheduled plan to deliver value to our customers.

Things You’ll Do

Build backend services and web interfaces while learning our stack
Implement features and fix bugs with guidance from teammates, using AI-assisted tools to work faster and learn more
Work with senior engineers to break down requirements, and make sure what you build works
Write well-tested code, review your own and AI-assisted work carefully, and give and receive feedback in code reviews
Learn our codebase and tools, and ask questions early
Collaborate with teammates, product, and design in the team’s agile practices to deliver value to customers

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
Prior software engineering experience through internships, co-ops, academic coursework, or personal/open-source projects
Solid algorithms, data structures, and coding fundamentals
Exposure to web infrastructure and distributed systems
Familiarity or experience with modern developer tools, git, unit testing, and continuous deployment concepts
Foundational understanding of clean coding principles, with a strong eagerness to learn, take guidance, and contribute to team goals

What You Should Know About This Team

Every great experience starts with knowing who you’re talking to. XM Directory is where that knowledge lives.
When a customer, employee, or other stakeholder interacts with a company, XM Directory can capture it and remember it. Over time, those moments add up to living profiles that show what people like, what they need, and how every interaction makes them feel.
That experience context helps close the Experience Gap, the distance between what people expect and what companies deliver, and it lets AI, including our Experience Agents, act in the moments that matter. As Qualtrics builds its next-generation XM Data & AI Platform, you’ll work on the data layer it depends on.
Behind that is an engineering team solving big-data problems: storage systems built to hold stakeholder data at scale, and computation and serving layers that make it fast and useful the moment someone needs it. When AI is acting inside a live customer moment, that data has to be fresh, accurate, and fast to reach. We pick the right tool for each job from a broad toolkit of open source and industry-proven technologies, including Elasticsearch, AWS DynamoDB, AWS Kinesis, Redis, and more.
As a Software Engineer I on the XMD team, you’ll build on your skills in distributed systems, frontend development, and databases. You’ll learn from senior engineers, take on meaningful problems early, and help build the data foundation that AI-powered experiences depend on.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks And Benefits

We spend 10% of our time on individual engineering growth activities every quarter
We participate in personalized Career Action Planning. You will work with your manager to design a plan based on your life experiences, values, and career aspirations (inside and outside Qualtrics) that helps you achieve your career goals at Qualtrics
Variable allowances for wellness, meals, transportation, and more.

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model:
Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid

Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws: Family & Medical Leave Act , Equal Opportunity Employment , Employee Polygraph Protection Act

Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.

Not finding a role that’s the right fit for now? Qualtrics Insiders is the one-stop shop for all things Qualtrics Life. Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics - upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. No spam - we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info - so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.

For full-time positions , this pay range is for base per year; however, base pay offered within this range may vary depending on location, job-related knowledge, education, skills, and experience. A sign-on bonus and restricted stock units may be included in an employment offer. jobs.description:
Costco IT is responsible for the technical future of Costco Wholesale
, the third largest retailer in the world with wholesale operations in fourteen countries. Despite our size and explosive international expansion, we continue to provide a family, employee centric atmosphere in which our employees thrive and succeed.

This is an environment unlike anything in the high-tech world
and the secret of Costco’s success is its culture. The value Costco puts on its employees is well documented in articles from a variety of publishers including Bloomberg and Forbes. Our employees and our members come FIRST. Costco is well known for its generosity and community service and has won many awards for its philanthropy. The company joins with its employees to take an active role in volunteering by sponsoring many opportunities to help others.

Come join the Costco Wholesale IT family
. Costco IT is a dynamic, fast-paced environment, working through exciting transformation efforts. We are building the next generation retail environment where you will be surrounded by dedicated and highly professional employees.

The Costco Digital Services Division is inviting students currently enrolled in an IT or related undergraduate or graduate program at a college or university to participate in a 12-week paid internship program during 2027. Interns will work within specific areas in Costco’s Information Systems Division. Interns will attend presentations given by various members of Executive Management from IT and other areas of the Company. At the end of the internship period, the intern will create and present a summary of their experience to their management and peers. Interns will be responsible for their own travel and accommodation expenses. Housing is not provided. The program runs mid-June to early September and is located in Issaquah, WA. No out of state work allowed. All interns are required to be in the office 5 days a week and must adhere to the CDS.

Costco’s International Depot team is leveraging modern enterprise programming languages, frameworks, and infrastructure to build innovative solutions for supporting Costco's business internationally in countries outside of the USA. This position is responsible for full-stack software development - from the user interface layer all the way to the database. Working with our team, you will have the support you need from our experienced software engineers to succeed in learning about our technology stack, strengthening your coding skills, and preparing for your career. You’ll work on features that will one-day be used by members and employees in our depots/warehouses/buying teams while getting fully immersed in the Costco Culture. We’re looking for motivated, capable, and team-oriented developers who have excellent coding skills, are intellectually curious, and are eager to contribute from day one.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer – AI and Automation (Team Breeze)
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$142,900.00 - $235,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

At Travelers, we're building the future of insurance — and Team Breeze is at the center of that work. This role puts you at the intersection of large language models (LLMs), cloud-native infrastructure, and real business impact. If you've shipped AI agent systems to production and want to do it again at scale, we'd like to talk.

What Will You Do?

Lead the design, configuration and development of complex, high-visibility AI applications on Team Breeze with a focus on LLM agents, retrieval pipelines and production reliability.
Design and implement agent orchestration flows using AWS Bedrock AgentCore and/or frameworks such as LangGraph, including tool calling, routing and prompt strategies for Claude models on Bedrock.
Own the retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline end to end — from document ingestion (SharePoint/LivePublish to S3), processing and embedding in Databricks, and serving from a vector store via Python retrieval APIs (FastAPI/Haystack) — including evaluation steps that measure retrieval and answer quality before each release.
Architect and build services on AWS using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront/Lambda@Edge, Route 53, Secrets Manager/Vault and Bedrock application inference profiles to track and manage cost.
Develop and operate containerized retrieval and evaluation services on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), deployed with Helm and ArgoCD, including OpenTelemetry collector integration exporting traces to Dynatrace, S3 and Braintrust.
Implement and maintain infrastructure as code and CI/CD using Terraform (Terraform Enterprise), GitHub Actions and TEP pipelines to deliver reliable, repeatable deployments.
Build and maintain the application layer across Python and TypeScript/Node 24 (Lambda xAPIs) and React 19/Vite for front-end UI experiences.
Lead investigation and resolution of critical, high-impact production issues, including debugging across AWS services, Kubernetes workloads, data pipelines and observability tooling.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to teammates, fostering strong engineering practices around design documentation, testing, evaluations, code reviews and operational readiness.
Continuously apply knowledge of current AI/LLM, cloud and observability trends to improve system design, developer productivity and business outcomes.
Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

LLM and Agent Systems
Demonstrated experience shipping LLM/agent systems to production — not just demos or prototypes.
Hands-on knowledge of tool calling, prompt and routing design, RAG retrieval quality tuning, and defining evaluations to measure LLM and retrieval performance.
Experience with Strands, LangGraph or Bedrock AgentCore is a plus.

Cloud, Infrastructure and Operations
Strong AWS serverless and EKS experience; able to design and debug systems spanning Lambda, API Gateway and Kubernetes-based containers in production.
Practical experience authoring and maintaining Terraform, Helm charts and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, TEP).
Observability fluency: tracing with OpenTelemetry or Dynatrace, structured logging with correlation IDs, cost tracking and incident handling.

Full-Stack and Data Pipeline Ownership
Comfortable working across Python and TypeScript/Node 24 in the service layer and React 19/Vite on the front end.
Familiar with data and retrieval pipelines from ingestion through embedding to vector-store-backed APIs.
Consistent habit of writing tests, evaluations and data-quality checks.

Delivery
Advanced delivery skills, including the ability to determine software design strategy and methodology, use automated tests and informed feedback loops to ensure quality and production readiness, and monitor the health of work efforts and adjacent systems.

Domain Expertise
Demonstrated track record of developing business partnerships and influencing priorities by identifying solutions aligned with current business objectives; closely follows industry trends relevant to the domain and shares knowledge with coworkers.

Problem Solving
Strong problem solver who uses data and proofs of concept to find creative solutions, reflects on outcomes, measures impact and uses that information to optimize — including decisions that involve a significant number of factors with broad implications.

Communication
Able to describe technology concepts in ways the business can understand, document initiatives clearly and concisely, collaborate effectively regardless of role, and give and receive constructive feedback; an attentive and empathetic listener.

Leadership
Takes action even when there is no clear owner; inspires and motivates others and is effective at influencing team members.

What is a Must Have?

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
6 additional years of software engineering experience.

What Is in It for You?

Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Labs
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

At Anthropic, we're building AI systems that are safe, beneficial, and transformative. Our mission is to develop AI that benefits humanity, and we believe the most powerful capabilities emerge when we thoughtfully bridge the gap between research breakthroughs and real-world applications.

Anthropic Labs serves as our internal accelerator. We're looking for the next breakout hits that bring substantial revenue or transform an industry. We operate in close partnership with research and build through fast iteration cycles. Past successes include Claude Code and MCP.

We're seeking versatile, entrepreneurial engineers to join Labs. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and real-world application, rapidly building and testing new experiences, working directly with researchers and users, and generating the insights that shape Anthropic's product future. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity, willing to kill your own projects when the data says to, and energized by the pace of building in uncharted territory.

Responsibilities

Rapidly prototype full-stack applications that showcase emerging AI capabilities, shipping early and often to maximize learning
Collaborate closely with research teams to understand new model capabilities and translate them into intuitive user experiences
Work directly with internal test users and external partners to gather feedback, iterate quickly, and validate (or invalidate) product concepts
Design and run structured experiments to test hypotheses, balancing creative exploration with rigorous evaluation
Generate documentation and insights to guide successful prototypes toward full product teams
Advocate for user experience and product considerations early in the research process
Provide feedback to research teams about model effectiveness and where capabilities can be improved
Flexibly contribute across Labs initiatives based on organizational priorities and emerging opportunities—context from one project should inform the next

You may be a good fit if you

Have 8+ years of experience building full-stack applications, with a track record of zero-to-one work in startup or startup-like environments
Thrive in ambiguity and are energized (not anxious) by uncertainty—you're comfortable working on projects that might not exist in three months
Have a hacker mentality: high agency, bias toward shipping, comfort with technical debt when it's the right tradeoff
Are deeply user-centric—you validate ideas with actual users before over-investing and talk about problems before solutions
Can articulate learnings from failed or killed projects without defensiveness; you treat your work as experiments
Hold strong opinions loosely—you advocate forcefully for ideas but change your mind based on evidence
Are a generalist who can transition between different problem spaces as priorities shift
Work independently with good judgment about what matters, without needing constant direction
Have strong technical skills across modern web development stacks (React, Node.js, Python, etc.) and are comfortable with APIs, databases, and cloud technologies
Communicate effectively and translate complex AI capabilities into intuitive experiences
Care about the societal impacts and ethics of your work

Strong candidates may also have

Experience building products that involve AI/ML components or working with large language models
Experience collaborating directly with research teams in AI/ML environments
Background conducting user research, interviews, and usability testing
Experience across both B2B and B2C product development, or in multiple industries
Design sensibility or hands-on experience with UI/UX for AI-powered applications
Experience with real-time applications, WebSocket implementations, or complex frontend interactions

What We're Not Looking For At This Stage

Deep specialists who can't adapt if their domain becomes irrelevant
Engineers who've only succeeded in big-company structures with well-defined processes and long timelines
People who are precious about their work or frame all past projects as successes
Those who need clear roadmaps and get stressed by shifting priorities

Candidates need not have

100% of the skills listed above
Formal certifications or education credentials
Direct machine learning or AI research experience

Deadline to apply:
None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$320,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Automation Engineering
jobs.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

NBCUniversal Advertising Products & Solutions (AP&S) is responsible for the product development and project management of NBCUniversal’s full advertising technology suite. From sales support to campaign execution, delivery, and billing, our division services both internal and external customers in support of NBCUniversal’s $7B+ annual advertising business. Together, we’re building the platform that powers the future of advertising at NBCU.

Our Data Collaboration Group, a core part of AP&S, powers the full advertiser lifecycle across insights, measurement, onboarding, activation, and optimization, utilizing various integration pathways including Data Clean Rooms and secure data shares.

Within the Data Collaboration Group, our Engineering & Operations team builds the automation and platform capabilities behind these workflows. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Automation Engineering to join the Engineering & Operations team. Reporting to the Director of Automation Engineering, this role will build AI-enabled automation systems and production-grade software that support NBCUniversal’s data collaboration ecosystem. 

The ideal candidate is a strong Python engineer who can design reliable systems, productize repeatable workflows, and build AI agents that help automate complex engineering and operational tasks across data platforms for audience activation, measurement, and reporting. 

Responsibilities:

AI Agent & Automation Engineering 

Design and build internal AI agents and automation workflows using technologies such as, Snowflake Cortex, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks, to support planning, tool use, retrieval, validation, and human-in-the-loop execution where appropriate. 

Develop reusable tools, APIs, and components that engineers can compose into new agentic workflows. 

Implement retrieval-augmented generation workflows, context management strategies, and prompt patterns that improve accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency. 

Agent Evaluation & Reliability 

Build evaluation harnesses, regression tests, and monitoring patterns for AI-agent behavior. 

Define and track metrics such as task completion, groundedness, response accuracy, latency, cost, and failure rate. 

Design guardrails and validation patterns to reduce hallucinations, unsafe outputs, and unreliable automation behavior. 

Partner with engineering and operations teams to move AI workflows from prototype to production-ready systems. 

Software Engineering & Platform Development 

Design, build, and maintain production-grade Python applications, libraries, and services. 

Champion object-oriented design principles, including encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance/composition, reusable interfaces, and clean separation of concerns to improve maintainability and extensibility. 

Champion software engineering best practices including modular design, automated testing, CI/CD, code reviews, observability, and documentation. 

Create reusable engineering patterns that reduce bespoke development effort and improve consistency across partner engagements.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Payments
jobs.description:
About Us

Our mission is to reinvent the way people learn, starting with language.

Learning a language can change a life by opening doors to new cultures, careers, and communities. Two billion people around the world are actively trying to learn a language, but the best way to learn (one-on-one tutoring) is hard to access at scale and hasn’t been meaningfully improved in decades. Speak is building a human-level, AI-powered tutor in your pocket: a conversation-first experience that lets learners actually speak, get instant feedback, and progress through carefully designed lessons. The result is a complete path from beginner to confident speaker across multiple languages.

Speak first launched in South Korea in 2019, where Speak has now become the number one language learning app, and we now serve learners across many markets and 15+ languages. Speak is one of the world’s leading AI companies, with over $150m raised in venture investment from OpenAI, Accel, Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and more, with a distributed team across San Francisco, Seoul, Tokyo, Taipei, and Ljubljana.

About This Role

We’re hiring our first dedicated payments engineer to own the reliability of payments at Speak. Every Speak payment is a subscription, and that revenue runs through Paddle, RevenueCat (the App Store and Google Play) and Stripe, with new providers on the way. Until now, payments work has been shared across teams without a single owner. You’ll be that owner: the point of contact and directly responsible engineer for how Speak bills, renews, and grants access to millions of learners.

You’ll start embedded with one of our growth teams, which also owns monetization, and over time anchor payments within our platform organization. As the first engineer in this area, you’ll set the architecture, standards, and roadmap for payments at Speak, with a high degree of autonomy and a direct line to revenue.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning the reliability of Speak’s subscription payments end to end, from purchase and renewal through cancellation, refunds, and entitlements
Building and maintaining our integrations with Paddle, RevenueCat, and Stripe in Node.js, and leading the rollout of new payment providers
Designing for correctness: idempotent webhook handling, reconciliation across providers, and safe retries
Putting monitoring, alerting, and runbooks in place so payment issues are caught before learners or finance notice them
Leading incident response and postmortems for payments, and fixing root causes
Setting the standards for how other teams change payments code, and reviewing changes that touch billing
Partnering with growth, product, finance, and support on pricing, paywall experiments, and revenue reporting
Mentoring engineers and raising the reliability bar across our backend

What We're Looking For

10+ years of software engineering experience, including staff-level ownership of production systems
Deep experience building and operating recurring subscription billing for a consumer product
Hands-on experience with App Store or Google Play billing (directly or through RevenueCat), Stripe Billing, or Paddle
Strong backend fundamentals in Node.js and TypeScript or a comparable language, with solid relational database skills
A track record of making payment systems more reliable: fewer incidents, cleaner reconciliation, safer migrations
Comfort defining your own roadmap in an area that doesn’t have one yet
Clear communication with engineering, product, and finance partners
Contributing to an AI-native development workflow — reviewing plans and designs before implementation, creating strong verification loops, and shipping safely with AI-assisted tooling
Excited about working in person in San Francisco at least 3 days per week

Nice to haves

Migrating between payment providers or consolidating several into one system
International payments, taxes, and currencies, especially across APAC markets
Worked on an app used by 1M+ users
Built entitlement systems shared across mobile and web

Why work at Speak

Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.
Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.
Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, Tokyo, and Taipei, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.
Impact people's lives in a major way: Learning a language is one of the single most life-changing skills one can learn, and right now 99% of people never achieve their goal because the process is broken. We’re helping millions of people achieve their goals and improve their lives.

Speak does not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

jobs.title: Sr Security Platform Engineer, AI and Automation
jobs.description:
Provides expert level IT technical lead services, including the direction, evaluation, selection, configuration, implementation, and integration of new and existing technologies and tools.

Global Enterprise Security (GES) partners with the lines of business across Vanguard to protect crew and client information and assets. Our sub-department, Attack Surface Reduction, provides a cohesive view into Vanguard's technical attack surface, focused on identifying, prioritizing, and managing vulnerabilities and configuration issues across the organization.

DevSecOps, part of Attack Surface Reduction, enhances the security posture of Vanguard's software applications through security automation that helps developers find and fix vulnerabilities earlier in the SDLC.

This role sits on the team responsible for orchestration and enforcement of our security scanning capabilities, including SAST, SCA, container scanning, and API security scanning. We build the platform that runs these scans across Vanguard's pipelines and enforces security policies, and we are extending it with AI capabilities that analyze findings and recommend remediation for developers. You will work closely with the engineers within our team, architects, Security Architecture and Engineering (SAEP), AI, Data and Platform Technology (ADAPT), IAM, Technical Security Advisors and teams across Attack Surface Reduction to shape how security testing is delivered at scale.

Responsibilities:

Lead the design, development, and implementation of secure, cloud-native platform services on AWS, leveraging technologies such as IAM, ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, RDS, S3, and CloudFormation.
Integrate application security tools and scanning capabilities into Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) pipelines, including onboarding new security scanners, normalizing findings, and translating results into enforceable security controls.
Partner with tech lead and architects on the technical direction for AI scanning capabilities and the AppSec AI Harness, taking agentic vulnerability analysis and remediation from proof of concept to a supported production capability.
Design integration patterns between AI capabilities and the security orchestration platform, including ingestion of security findings, validation of AI-generated remediation, and measurement of output quality as models and prompts evolve.
Partner with technical leads and architects to integrate AI capabilities into the broader platform architecture, engineering standards, and delivery roadmap.
Serve as a technical subject matter expert for AI-enabled application security, establishing practical approaches for applying AI to security challenges across DevSecOps.
Design and develop APIs, event-driven integrations, automation services, and CI/CD capabilities that enable reliable, scalable security testing and simplify adoption for development teams.
Improve the reliability and scalability of the orchestration platform and AI capabilities through automation, observability, and self-service capabilities.
Collaborate with security and engineering teams to embed secure development practices throughout the development lifecycle, including Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), container security, and API security testing.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship, promoting high-quality software engineering practices and strengthening the team's capabilities in AI, application security, and platform engineering.
Partner with stakeholders to establish technical direction, manage technical risks, and deliver business-critical solutions, including determining where AI provides meaningful value within application security.
Collaborate with DevSecOps leaders to align engineering priorities and deliverables with strategic initiatives as business and technology needs evolve.
Drive continuous improvement across platform architecture, engineering standards, security practices, and operational excellence.

Required Qualifications

12+ years of experience in software engineering, application development, or platform engineering, including 8+ years of hands-on software development experience.
Undergraduate degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education, training, and experience; graduate degree preferred.
Strong expertise in AWS cloud technologies and cloud-native application and platform architectures.
Strong software engineering and programming fundamentals, with the ability to work effectively across multiple programming languages. Current technologies include Node.js and TypeScript, with Python particularly valuable for AI and large language model development.
Hands-on experience building agentic AI solutions, including multi-step, tool-using agents integrated into production systems.
Experience integrating large language models (LLMs) into production applications, including prompt design, tool/function calling, context management, cost optimization, and latency management.
Practical experience evaluating the quality and reliability of AI-generated output, including establishing release criteria and identifying degradation after deployment.
Experience designing and implementing APIs, distributed systems, automation solutions, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience operating production platform services, including applying observability, reliability, and operational engineering practices.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, collaborate and influence across organizational boundaries, and mentor engineers.
Ability and willingness to learn and apply new technologies as platforms, AI capabilities, and security requirements evolve.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Amazon Bedrock, including model selection, guardrails, and evaluating trade-offs among hosted models.
Experience in application security, DevSecOps, or secure software development, including commercial security scanning platforms such as Snyk, Wiz, or JFrog Xray.
Experience building automated code remediation or developer-facing security tooling, particularly solutions where accuracy and false-positive management are critical to developer adoption.
Experience partnering with enterprise AI and data platform teams to use shared AI services while aligning with organizational standards for model access and data handling.
Experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or CI/CD engineering, including building services and pipelines used by application and product teams across an enterprise.
Experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale automation solutions adopted by multiple teams.
AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate or Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, or AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate.
Demonstrated applied AI engineering experience through production AI systems, open-source contributions, or published work. Practical, demonstrated experience is valued over certification alone.

Special Factors

Sponsorship

Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.

About Vanguard

At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission.

To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best.

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

jobs.title: Network Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a leading global insurance organization. AIG member companies provide a wide range of property casualty insurance in approximately 70 countries and jurisdictions. These diverse offerings include products and services that help businesses and individuals protect their assets and manage risks.

We’re also committed to making a positive difference for our colleagues and in the communities where we work and live. We encourage colleagues to give back to the causes they care most about, supporting these efforts through our Volunteer Time Off and Matching Grants Programs.

Get to know the business

At AIG, technology is at the heart of everything we do, from underwriting risks to processing claims. The Information Technology team equips our colleagues with the latest tools to complete their work efficiently and with the highest standards of excellence. The team is responsible for shielding the company’s systems from security risks, while designing technology strategies that enable AIG’s businesses to achieve their goals. AIG’s Information Technology functions include enterprise architecture, software and systems engineering, cybersecurity, and technology risk and compliance.

About The Role

We are looking for a Network Automation Engineer
to help build and scale automation across our enterprise network environment. You’ll combine strong networking knowledge with software and automation skills to reduce manual work, improve network reliability, and enable API-driven operations. A key part of the role will be developing and operating our Network Source of Truth (SSoT/NSoT)
using Nautobot
, and integrating it with network infrastructure, automation, observability, and other enterprise platforms. We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving real network problems with Python, APIs, Ansible, Git, and modern automation practices
, not simply administering network devices.

Requirements

What Success Looks Like

Design and build network automation for provisioning, configuration, validation, migrations, and operational workflows.
Help lead the implementation and ongoing development of Nautobot as the Network Source of Truth.
Integrate Nautobot and other network platforms using REST APIs, GraphQL, and Python.
Develop reusable automation using Python, Ansible, Jinja2, Terraform, and related technologies.
Automate synchronization and validation of network inventory, IPAM, configuration, and operational data.
Build automated pre-change and post-change validation to make network changes safer and more reliable.
Apply Git, CI/CD, testing, and Infrastructure as Code practices to network automation.
Integrate automation with network management, observability, and enterprise platforms.
Troubleshoot complex issues spanning networks, automation, APIs, and data.
Partner with network architects, engineering and operations teams to identify opportunities for automation and improve how the network is operated.
Evaluate and prototype emerging network automation technologies and capabilities.

Qualifications

7+ years of network engineering, network automation, or related experience in large enterprise environments.
Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, routing and switching, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, and IPAM.
Strong Python development or scripting skills.
Hands-on experience with Ansible or similar automation platforms.
Experience building integrations using REST APIs and working with JSON/YAML.
Experience with a network Source of Truth, IPAM, DCIM, or inventory platform, ideally Nautobot or NetBox.
Experience with Git and CI/CD practices.
Experience automating network technologies from vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Arista, F5, or similar.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, architecture, operations, and technology teams.

Preferred Skills

Hands-on experience developing Nautobot Jobs, Apps/plugins, APIs, GraphQL integrations, or data models.
Experience with NetBox, Nornir, Netmiko, NAPALM, pyATS, Jinja2, or similar automation technologies.
Familiarity with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and Linux environments.
Cloud networking experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Knowledge of VXLAN/EVPN, controller-based networking, intent-based networking, or SDN.
Relevant Cisco, Juniper, DevNet, cloud, or automation certifications.

You’ll help move network operations from manual, device-by-device processes toward automated, data-driven workflows, with Nautobot serving as a trusted source of network data and APIs, automation, validation, and CI/CD providing the foundation for scalable network operations.

Ready to step up to new challenges? We would love to hear from you.
