new_jobs.description:
At AMEWAS, we don’t just support defense- we shape it. For over 40 years, we’ve been a trusted partner of the Department of Defense (DoD) by providing cutting-edge engineering, testing, and evaluation for U.S. Navy weapons systems.

Our people are the heart of our mission. Across our headquarters in California, Maryland, and offices in Orlando, FL, and San Diego, CA, you'll find a diverse and driven team committed to making a real impact for our Nation’s Warfighters.

If you're ready to grow your skills, be challenged by meaningful work, and contribute to something bigger…this is where you belong.

Come do work that matters. Join AMEWAS.

The Position

AMEWAS is seeking a highly motivated and talented Software Developer-Junior. The salary range of this position is $87,100.00 - $110,000.00 and is commensurate with experience. This position is not eligible for remote work; on-site support is required.

About the location:

Patuxent River, MD, located in the California-Lexington Park area, is Maryland’s #1 City Hiring the Most High-Tech Workers. To learn more about the surrounding area, please visit: www.visitstmarysmd.com

Work Arrangement

Remote or hybrid work arrangements are subject to business, contract, customer, and/or government requirements and may be modified or discontinued as needed. The Company reserves the right to require an employee to report to a designated Company or customer worksite when business or contractual requirements change.

Position Background

The Guardian Software Development team is responsible for periodic releases of the components that make up the Guardian Software Suite. They will provide safety critical engineering services for the Atlantic Test Range Guardian systems. The team provides engineering services to include Software Engineering, Independent Software and System Testing, System Fabrication, Information Technology (IT), Financial Management Analyst support, etc. to the Guardian program. Software Engineers support will include but not limited to design, development, documentation and testing of all components that make up the Guardian System software suite. The team will provide location site surveys, site installations and customer support services along with system component acquisition, publication development and configuration management.

A Typical Day As a Software Developer-Junior May Include

Provides safety critical engineering services for the Atlantic Test Range Guardian systems
Supports the design, development, documentation, and testing of all components that make up the Guardian System software suite and the UAV Detect and Avoid System
Develops software for a safety critical UAV Detect and Avoid system
Documents software to DO-278 standards
Supports software development, software integration, and customer training/demonstrations
Demonstrates knowledge of standard programming algorithms, design patterns, and object-oriented software design
Evaluates and reviews C++ language code

Must-haves

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering from an ABET accredited college
1 year of experience working as a Software Developer
Experience with scripting and programming in C++ or other object-oriented programming languages (Java and/or Python)
Experience with Git or equivalent configuration management tools
Experience with QT
Minimum clearance required to apply (candidates who do not currently hold the required clearance will not be considered): N/A
Current clearance required upon onboarding: DoD Secret Clearance
Additional Accesses: The ability to obtain and maintain the DoD security clearance eligibility and/or additional security access requirements necessary to perform the duties of the position, as required by the contract. U.S. Citizenship is required for all clearances.

Desired Skills

Experience with Jira
Experience with Linux
Experience RHEL
Experience with network programming

Security Clearance Requirement Disclaimer:
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain all security clearances, interim security determinations, and/or other access authorizations required by the applicable contract(s). Candidates who are unable to obtain the required interim clearance or access authorization within the timeframe necessary to meet business and contract requirements may no longer be considered for employment.

Employment Eligibility and Sponsorship Disclaimer:
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. AMEWAS is unable to provide employment-based visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future.

Skills Crucial To Success At AMEWAS

Candidates must demonstrate a customer-focused mindset, professionalism, and discretion, while working collaboratively with management and teams to meet objectives. Candidates should be hard-working individuals with strong attention to detail and the ability to foster a positive, team-oriented culture.

Physical Environment And Working Conditions

The physical environment for this position requires the employee to work in an office, sitting in a cubicle or at a desk, looking at a computer for most of the workday. Work is physically comfortable. The employee has discretion about sitting, walking, standing, etc.

The employee may be required to travel short distances to offices/conference rooms and buildings on site or near the work site. Overnight travel will be required.

About ITradeNetwork

At iTradeNetwork, we provide advanced supply chain software and insights tailored to the food & beverage industry. Our mission is clear and ambitious: To feed the world.
From the start, we’ve been dedicated to tackling the most pressing challenges within food and beverage supply chains, delivering innovative solutions and expert support that make a measurable impact.

Our cutting-edge technology helps businesses streamline complex procurement and fulfillment processes, minimize food waste, optimize inventory, manage compliance risk, and scale profitably. We’re proud to serve an elite customer base, including 13 of the top 25 North American grocers, 8 of the top 10 foodservice distributors, and 8 of the top 10 global food and beverage manufacturers.

Today, we're building an AI-first company — meaning AI isn't a feature we bolt on, it's the foundation for how we design products, make decisions, and ship software. Cerena is proof of that in action: powered by the most connected supply chain network in food and beverage, iTradeNetwork's Solution Suite replaces error-prone manual workflows with faster, smarter tools — driving real results for our customers, and ultimately, for the consumers who depend on them.

iTradeNetwork's Leadership Principles

iTradeNetwork’s purpose is to feed the world — and everything we do is guided by the principles below. Every team member is expected to embody and champion these principles across the organization.

Bias for Action

We value speed and avoid analysis paralysis. We develop conviction, make informed decisions quickly, and take calculated risks to maintain momentum — knowing that swift progress is essential for innovation and growth.

Customer Obsession

We work relentlessly to delight our customers. We work backward from their needs to solve pain points and create solutions that surprise and earn their loyalty. We obsess over customers, not competitors.

Data & Metrics Driven

We operate with facts, not opinions. We dive deep into data and use metrics to measure progress, ground every decision in rigorous analysis, and push for clarity and measurable outcomes.

Raise the Bar

We continuously push for improvement — in ourselves, our teams, and the company. We hire and develop exceptional talent, setting ever-higher standards that elevate performance and drive excellence.

Operational Excellence Through Process

We build lasting processes that optimize for efficiency. By developing, testing, and documenting each process, we create consistency and scale through automation, enabling continuous improvement across the business.

Ownership Mindset

We take responsibility for our work and aim for long-term success. We use resources wisely, stay accountable, and roll up our sleeves to get things done — no task is beneath us.

Earn Trust

We build trust through integrity, transparency, and mutual respect. We communicate openly, own our mistakes, listen actively, and remain open to feedback as an opportunity for growth.

Job Summary

We are building an AI-first company — which means AI isn’t a feature we bolt on; it’s the foundation of how we design products, make decisions, and ship software. As an AI/ML Software Engineer, you’ll be on the front lines of that mission: building intelligent, production-ready applications that put machine learning at the core of the user experience.

This is a role for someone who has built a solid foundation and is ready to take on more. You’ll deliver well-scoped features and services with increasing independence, partner with senior engineers and data scientists on larger initiatives, and deepen your expertise at the intersection of AI/ML and full stack development — all in service of one of the most consequential industries in the world.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and ship AI-powered full stack features — from model integration to user-facing interfaces — using modern frameworks and cloud-native infrastructure, with growing independence on well-scoped work.
Partner with data scientists to productionize ML models: wrapping them in APIs, implementing and tuning inference pipelines, and monitoring performance and reliability in live environments.
Build and maintain data pipelines that support model training, validation, and deployment workflows, including data quality checks and basic observability.
Develop frontend experiences (React or similar) that surface AI-driven insights in intuitive, responsive interfaces.
Develop and maintain backend services and microservices that power model serving, data ingestion, and business logic — writing well-tested, documented code and helping troubleshoot and resolve production issues.
Participate in code reviews and collaborative design discussions — giving constructive feedback to peers, incorporating feedback from senior engineers, and contributing your own perspective.
Stay current with the AI/ML landscape and bring practical ideas back to the team — new tooling, frameworks, and LLM techniques — through small evaluations, prototypes, or demos.

Required

What you’ll need:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
2–3 years of professional software engineering experience, including shipping and maintaining production code, ideally on AI/ML-enabled or data-intensive applications.
Solid working knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and software design fundamentals, applied to write clean, testable code.
Working knowledge of core AI/ML concepts: supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, model evaluation, and how models are deployed and served in production.
Proficiency in Python (strongly preferred given its centrality to the ML ecosystem) or another backend language, with experience building and maintaining APIs and services.
Hands-on professional experience with web development (React, Angular, or comparable framework) building user-facing features.
Working experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases, including schema design and query optimization.
A problem-solving mindset and genuine curiosity about how AI can change the way software works.

Nice To Have

Hands-on experience with Python ML libraries: TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and deploying ML workloads in the cloud.
Experience integrating LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns into applications.
Working knowledge of MLOps tooling: experiment tracking, model registries, CI/CD for ML pipelines.
Experience taking an AI/ML application from prototype to production, whether in a professional setting or through significant project work.

Who You Are

You think AI-first — when approaching a problem, your instinct is to ask how intelligence can be built into the solution, not added as an afterthought (Raise the Bar)
You move fast and learn faster. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the pace of change in the AI space (Bias for Action)
You take ownership. You don’t wait to be told what to do next; you find the next important thing and work on it (Ownership Mindset)
You care about craft — clean code, thoughtful documentation, and systems that are built to last. (Customer Obsession)

The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Driver Refinement and Validation’s (DRV) mission is to build upon the high-quality ML Driver developed by Driver Intelligence, refining its performance to improve autonomous driving in specific, complex real-world contexts and problem areas (e.g., Ride-Hailing contexts). It aims to ensure that the Waymo Driver always computes safe, compliant, comfortable, and useful plans. As an Engineer in DRV, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge machine learning and real-world vehicle performance, engineering the validation and onboard systems that ensure the autonomous vehicle reliably executes intelligent and predictable maneuvers.

You Will

Develop next-generation, ML-powered systems that enhance the capabilities of the ML driver and accelerate the rapid scaling of Waymo’s business
Fine-tune, adapt, and benchmark state-of-the-art generative models to improve autonomous vehicle perception, motion prediction, and trajectory planning
Write high-quality, scalable, and thoroughly tested code to bring cutting-edge ML into production
Partner with world-class engineers and product managers to deliver safe and smooth autonomous vehicle behaviors

You Have

MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
3+ years of industry experience deploying, evaluating, and maintaining ML-based systems in real-world, production environments
Proficient programming skills in Python and/or C++, coupled with strong analytical and debugging abilities
Expertise with modern deep learning frameworks, such as JAX or PyTorch

We Prefer

Experience in deep learning, reinforcement learning, and ML systems
Domain expertise in solving prediction, behaviors, motion planning, or related robotics problems
ML post-training experience

At Nicolet National Bank, our culture is based on the principles of community banking, putting the needs of our customers at the forefront of our decision-making. Our Core Values drive everything we do, and we are committed to serving our customers with excellence. We believe that every job in our organization is critical to our success, and we are dedicated to creating a work environment where our employees feel valued, respected, and supported. With locations in Wisconsin, Michigan, Minnesota, Iowa, and Florida we are proud to service our local communities and make a positive impact on the lives of our customers. At Nicolet National Bank, we believe that our people are our most valuable asset, and we are committed to investing in their growth and development.

The Automation Engineer
is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and supporting scalable automation solutions that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and improve business processes across Nicolet.

This role partners with business analysts, subject matter experts, and technology teams to understand business requirements and determine the most appropriate automation approach, such as APIs, system integrations, workflow automation, RPA, data pipelines, or native application capabilities. The Automation Engineer applies sound engineering practices to translate validated requirements into well-designed, supportable, and secure automation solutions.

As An Automation Engineer, You Will

Design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable automation solutions across enterprise applications and business processes, managing each solution throughout its lifecycle, including enhancements, dependencies, technical debt, platform upgrades, and retirement.
Assess automation opportunities identified by product owners, subject matter experts, and business partners, providing technical feasibility, level of effort, and risk input to support prioritization decisions.
Partner with product owners and subject matter experts to review and clarify business requirements, confirm process and data details, and validate that proposed automation designs meet business needs before development begins.
Evaluate solution alternatives including APIs, integrations, workflow automation, RPA, and native system capabilities to select maintainable and scalable approaches.
Integrate automations with enterprise applications and data platforms using APIs, SQL, Snowflake, Alteryx, and other appropriate technologies.
Establish and maintain automation engineering standards covering architecture, source control, documentation, testing, peer review, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management in coordination with the Nicolet development team.
Monitor production automations, troubleshoot failures, manage exceptions, perform root cause analysis, and improve reliability and performance.
Develop reusable automation components, integrations, frameworks, and design patterns to improve consistency and accelerate delivery.
Ensure automations adhere to information security, access management, data protection, audit, change management, business continuity, and regulatory requirements.
Partner with application, infrastructure, security, data, and support teams to ensure solutions are documented and can be effectively supported.
Evaluate emerging automation capabilities and recommend opportunities to improve the bank's automation platform and engineering practices.
Uphold Nicolet’s philosophy and policies by maintaining appropriate controls to ensure full compliance with applicable laws and regulations, thereby fulfilling legal responsibilities and enhancing the quality of services provided by Nicolet.
Understand and communicate the value of diversity within the workplace and to work successfully with others without regard to age, gender, race, sexual orientation, ethnicity, culture, religion, disability status, socioeconomic status or other non-job-related classification, including a commitment to Nicolet’s policies on equal employment opportunities and non-discrimination with a willingness to pursue efforts of inclusion and respect toward different perspectives.
Performs all other duties as assigned.

This position is initially an individual contributor role with the potential to evolve into technical leadership or direct supervisory responsibility as Nicolet's automation program grows.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
4+ years of experience developing and supporting enterprise automation, RPA, workflow or integration solutions.
Hands-on experience with automation platforms such as UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate.
Experience establishing automation development, quality assurance, or governance standards preferred.
Financial services or other regulated-industry experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process-design skills, including the ability to translate business requirements into sound automation designs.
Proficiency with enterprise automation technologies, preferably UiPath and/or Microsoft Power Automate.
Experience integrating automation solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and data platforms.
Working knowledge of SQL and data integration concepts, with exposure to data platforms.
Understanding of SDLC, source control, CI/CD, automated testing, and release management practices.
Understanding of automation architecture, exception handling, monitoring, logging, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to elicit and clarify requirements from subject matter experts and to explain technical options to non-technical audiences.

Citizenship:
U.S. citizens only

About US Air Tech

US Air Tech Corporation – USAT is developing advanced UAS (Unmanned Aerial Systems – drones), AI-driven robotic controls, navigation, and communication technologies through its STELLA® platform. The company’s technology roadmap includes compact electronic systems for UAS, satellite communication payloads, high-frequency antenna systems, ultra-sensitive receivers, and integrated communication architectures for LEO satellite networks, IoT connectivity, defense communication, and space-air-ground applications.

Position Summary

USAT is seeking a Software Engineer to design, develop, integrate, and test software for our UAS platforms and RF/communications payloads. The work spans flight-control and navigation software, AI-driven autonomy and robotic control, antenna and modem control, and embedded software for FPGA, ASIC, and microcontroller-based hardware. The ideal candidate combines strong programming skills with hands-on experience in UAS, navigation, or embedded communications systems, and works closely with RF, FPGA, ASIC, electrical, mechanical, and systems engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and integrate flight-control, navigation, and autonomy software using UAS open-source stacks (e.g., PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, ROS 2).
Develop software for communication protocols, telemetry, command/control, data acquisition, hardware interfaces, system monitoring, and engineering test workflows.
Support UAS-related software workflows such as satellite tracking support, pass prediction integration, link monitoring, modem control, Doppler compensation support, antenna pointing support, and communication status reporting.
Develop embedded and application-level software for FPGA-connected, ASIC-connected, microprocessor-based, and microcontroller-based communication systems.
Implement software interfaces for RF front ends, modems, SDR platforms, ADC/DAC systems, antenna control units, power systems, sensors, and test equipment over interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, and Ethernet.
Build software-in-the-loop (SIL) and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation, automated test frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines for prototype and product software.
Support lab and field flight testing: collect and analyze logs, troubleshoot integration issues, and feed results back into design.
Develop clear technical documentation, software architecture diagrams, interface control documents, test procedures, user guides, and release notes.
Support software version control, build management, code reviews, issue tracking, and release readiness for prototype and product software.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field.
3+ years of professional experience in software engineering for UAS, robotics, embedded systems, communication systems, or hardware-control software.
Strong programming experience in C or C++ and Python; experience with Rust, Go, Java, or MATLAB is a plus.
Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: a UAS autopilot stack (PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink), ROS/ROS 2, embedded firmware development, or SDR/RF hardware-control software.
Proficiency with Git, code review, and issue tracking; strong software architecture, documentation, and cross-functional communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Embedded Linux and RTOS experience (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and real-time constraints.
Experience with SIL/HIL simulation, test automation, and CI/CD.

Work Environment, Security, and Compliance

On-site work in Tucson, AZ, including lab work and field testing.
U.S. citizenship is required.

Startup Environment and Expectations

USAT operates as a fast-moving startup focused on advanced UAS, RF, and antenna system development. Candidates should be prepared for an intense, hands-on engineering environment where priorities can move quickly, technical challenges are demanding, and individual ownership matters. Engineers are expected to be willing to contribute across design, testing, prototyping, troubleshooting, and documentation as needed.

What Success Looks Like

This role is expected to quickly become a key contributor to US Air Tech’s software capability, helping convert UAS and RF system requirements into reliable, testable, and field-ready software. In the first 1-2 months, candidate will learn the STELLA® software architecture, toolchain, and target hardware; land their first reviewed contribution and add automated tests. Subsequently, they will own a defined component, such as a hardware driver, protocol implementation, or antenna-control module, with a documented interface and tests.

Compensation and Benefits

Final compensation will be based on experience, education, and demonstrated software engineering, communication systems, UAS, embedded software, and hardware-integration expertise.

Equal Opportunity Statement

USAT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from diverse software engineering, computer science, computer engineering, and communication systems backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive engineering team focused on next-generation UAS, RF systems, and field-deployable communication technologies.

How to Apply

Send your resume to contact@usairtechcorp.com with the subject line “Software Engineer – [Your Name].” In your resume or cover note, highlight your experience with UAS, navigation, and embedded or RF software, and confirm that you are a U.S. citizen.

This role is not eligible for sponsorship AND is four days onsite hybrid at our N. Scottsdale, AZ office - OR - Rockville, MD HQ **

Who are we looking for?

Choice Hotels, one of the world’s largest lodging franchisors, has an exciting new opportunity as our Data Engineer II
in the Data Engineering
team within our Advanced Analytics Team. The Data Engineering
team is the team that builds and maintains the data pipelines and tools that turn information from across our business into reliable, ready-to-use data for analysts, business leaders, and applications. As a key member of our Data Engineering
team, you will turn business questions into trusted data solutions that help leaders across Choice Hotels make faster, better decisions.

Are you a hands-on problem solver with strong SQL and Python skills who enjoys partnering directly with business teams? We invite you to apply today for our Data Engineer II role and #MakeItYourChoice
.

Your Responsibilities

Design, build, maintain, and optimize batch extract-transform-load (ETL/ELT) pipelines and data models that power analytics, reporting, and business operations, with a focus on performance, scalability, reliability, and efficient resource use.
Partner with business operations and regional leaders to clarify requirements, define metrics, establish delivery expectations, and prioritize work based on business impact.
Deliver items from the data and analytics backlog, including pipelines, models, dashboards, and ad hoc requests, and reduce future demand by automating recurring requests and building reusable, self-serve data assets.
Protect the quality and consistency of key business metrics across regions and systems by implementing automated data validation, transformation testing, reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting to confirm data accuracy, completeness, and freshness.
Monitor production pipelines, troubleshoot failures, investigate data discrepancies, implement corrective actions, and document recurring issues to improve reliability and reduce operational overhead, including participation in the on-call rotation.
Support the evaluation and migration of our data integration tools, including pipeline inventory, validation, parallel runs, and retirement of legacy jobs.
Support our internal conversational analytics application by maintaining data connections, improving data quality for its answers, and helping measure usage and accuracy.
Prototype quickly with users, gather feedback, and turn successful prototypes into production-ready solutions.
Write clean, tested, well-documented code and take part in code and design reviews.
Document standards and runbooks (step-by-step operating guides), and provide training and hands-on support to drive adoption of delivered solutions.

Your Experience, Skills & Competencies

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required, or equivalent experience.
At least 3 years’ experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or software engineering.
Strong SQL and Python skills.
Hands-on experience with modern ELT/ETL tools (e.g., dbt, Fivetran, Airbyte, Airflow, Matillion) and a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).
Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices for data pipelines, including automated testing, version-controlled deployments, and promotion of changes across development and production environments, using tools such as Harness, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions.
Proficiency with Git-based source control (e.g., Bitbucket, GitHub, GitLab), including pull requests and branching strategies.
Familiarity with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Solid understanding of data modeling concepts, such as dimensional modeling and slowly changing dimensions.
Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and make sound tradeoffs in a fast-moving environment.
Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
Demonstrates key competencies to include: Cultivates Innovation, Action Oriented, Nimble Learning.
Preferred: experience with infrastructure as code and containerization (e.g., Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes) and with data governance and observability tools (e.g., Monte Carlo, Great Expectations).
Preferred: experience with data platform or tooling migrations, applications that use large language models (LLMs) or conversational interfaces, or business intelligence tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

Your Team

This is an individual contributor role that will report to the Manager, Data Engineering. You will have 3 peer teammate(s) and collaborate with cross functional departments on a regular basis.

Your Work Location

As our Data Engineer II, you will be based in our beautiful, state-of-the-art worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, MD. Less than 15 miles from Washington, DC, we’re located one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with service on the Red Line and the MARC Brunswick line, easy access to I-270, and plenty of free parking provided by Choice Hotels.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $107,000 to $127,000 annually.

The pay range listed is for this position and is what Choice Hotels reasonably expects to pay. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the pay range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, and business or organizational needs.

PLEASE NOTE: This role is not eligible for sponsorship ***

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
Employee recognition programs
Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

North Bethesda, MD
— Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

— Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Summary

We are seeking a Full Stack Software Developer to design, build, and own the internal software systems that power our manufacturing operations. This is a high-autonomy role spanning the entire stack; from front-end dashboards and back-end services to equipment-level communication protocols where you will drive architecture decisions and deliver end-to-end solutions across MES/RMS integrations, production monitoring tools, and SECS/GEM host software. The ideal candidate pairs strong C#/.NET fundamentals with the initiative to define systems in a growing environment, not just maintain them.
You will join a team of approximately ten engineers within the MIS department, working alongside MES, database, and systems engineering colleagues in an open office environment with occasional time in cleanroom manufacturing areas. As AOI scales U.S. production capacity to meet accelerating AI datacenter demand, this role will be central to building the software infrastructure that supports higher throughput, better yield and yield visibility, with more reliable equipment automation.

Responsibilities

Internal Web Application Development
Design, develop, own, and maintain full-stack web applications for internal manufacturing operations, including production dashboards, equipment monitoring portals, and operational tools.
Build responsive front-end interfaces and robust back-end services using C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core, Blazor) as the primary stack, with JavaScript/TypeScript as a secondary development stack.
Implement scalable and maintainable software architectures that serve multiple teams across manufacturing, process engineering, quality, and operations.
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code that adheres to best practices and coding standards.

Equipment Automation & SECS/GEM
Maintain and enhance EAP (Equipment Automation Program) software that enables communication between manufacturing equipment and factory systems.
Configure and maintain SECS/GEM communication in compliance with SEMI standards (e.g., SECS-I, HSMS, GEM), including equipment messaging, event reporting, alarms, status variables, and remote command execution.
Support equipment qualification and acceptance testing using SECS/GEM requirements.

System Integration
Integrate manufacturing tools with:
MES (Manufacturing Execution System) for lot tracking and production control
RMS (Recipe Management System) for recipe download, validation, and version control
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Process Engineering, Manufacturing, IT, Quality) to ensure seamless system interoperability.

Data Collection, Analysis & Dashboards
Build and maintain web-based dashboards for:
Production performance monitoring and yield analysis
Equipment health and downtime tracking
Utilize SQL databases to store, query, and analyze production and equipment data.
Support continuous improvement initiatives through data-driven insights and visualization.

Troubleshooting & Production Support
Diagnose and resolve complex equipment automation, communication, and data integrity issues in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
Provide support during production issues related to automation systems as needed.
Work directly with equipment vendors to resolve interface or protocol issues.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement
Develop and maintain software design documents, interface control documents (ICDs), and operational procedures.
Ensure systems comply with internal controls, quality standards, and audit requirements.
Identify automation opportunities to improve throughput, reduce manual intervention, and enhance equipment utilization.
Stay current on emerging technologies and propose system enhancements aligned with AOI’s manufacturing roadmap.

Qualifications

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
Required
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related STEM discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
3–5 years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong proficiency in C# / .NET development (ASP.NET Core, Blazor, Entity Framework, or similar frameworks).
Solid experience with SQL databases (queries, joins, stored procedures, performance tuning).
Exposure and experience with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript) and modern web frameworks.
Experience with RESTful API design and back-end service development.
Proficiency with version control (Git) and collaborative development workflows.
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
Mandarin speaking is a must.

Preferred
Working knowledge of EAP systems, SECS/GEM protocols, and SEMI standards.
Experience with MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems) integration in semiconductor, optoelectronics, or high-volume electronics manufacturing environments.
Experience with Python and/or LabVIEW.
Familiarity with cloud services (Azure, AWS, GCP) and CI/CD pipelines.

Location & Work Environment

This position is full-time and based in Sugar Land, Texas. This location has a combination of office, warehouse, and cleanroom manufacturing work environments.
Business Hours for this position are 9am to 6pm CT, Monday through Friday.
This position may require occasional after-hours response for critical facility issues, site inspections, or executive events.

Why AOI?

In addition to competitive salary, AOI offers:
Flexible and competitive health (medical, dental, vision) plans offer the employee with the right options to meet individual and family needs
Employer matching on 401(k) deferrals
Generous PTO policy, with unused PTO payout at end of the year
Relocation packages available within the United States.

new_jobs.description:
Hemlock Semiconductor (HSC) is a leading global provider of hyper pure polysilicon, an essential material used in the semiconductor and solar industries. From smartphones in your pocket to satellites in orbit, our materials play a foundational role in modern technology.

At HSC, employees do work that matters. Team members are part of a safety focused organization that values teamwork, excellence, responsibility and customer focus. Rooted in Michigan for more than 65 years, HSC continues to evolve through innovation, operational discipline and a strong commitment to its people and communities.

This role contributes to HSC’s ongoing work and long-term success by supporting teams, processes and priorities that keep operations running effectively.

Summary

The AI Vision Machine Learning Engineer
will design and implement advanced analytical models to extract insights from static images and video within the manufacturing environment. This role focuses on object measurement, classification, anomaly detection, and leveraging these insights to build predictive and recommendation algorithms that deliver measurable business value. The developer will also articulate benefits to stakeholders, ensuring adoption and prioritization of operationalization.

Essential Functions

Visual Inspect & Quality Control: Develop, train, and refine deep learning models for automated perception tasks in the manufacturing environment, such as object detection, classification, measurement, and anomaly identification.
Edge Deployment & Factory Integration: Optimize and deploy trained models onto edge devices (e.g. NVIDIA Jetson, industrial PCs, PLCs, smart cameras) in the manufacturing environment, in collaboration with control system team.
Cloud & Server Integration for Real-Time Analysis: Leverage cloud infrastructure (e.g. Azure Foundry, DevOps, GitHub, Fabric) as appropriate for model training, deployment, governance, and downstream data availability.
Partner with manufacturing and process engineering teams to ensure models address real-world operational needs and drive the operationalization of developed models into production workflows and communicate value.
Report and monitor model performance using BI tools (Spotfire / Power BI) and communicate actionable insights. Develop and implement optimization and maintenance plans for validation and retraining of models as appropriate.

Additional Responsibilities

Collaborate with Data & Analytics team members to drive excellence in data science model building, model management, and deployment.
Work with procurement and external suppliers to leverage external expertise in key technologies or integration capabilities
Support data science and enterprise reporting initiatives within the wider analytics ecosystem.
Support Data & Analytics team initiatives around governance, data quality & management, and Community of Practice.
Stay informed of new and planned improvements in data management, visualization, modeling, visual analysis, and integration technologies across the industry and communicate their potential value/impact to our analytics practice.
Communicate business value to business users and leaders through identification of opportunities to explore and apply machine vision analytics in new ways.

Skills

Strong proficiency in computer vision techniques (OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Knowledge of Machine Vision systems and related hardware (cameras, optics, lighting, IOT, networking, etc)
Expertise in image/video processing, including but not limited to feature extraction, classification, edge finding, and morphology.
Solid understanding of predictive modeling techniques and model governance.
Programming skills in Python, C++/C#, or similar and familiarity with visual analytics libraries and code and task management (GitHub, DevOps).
Ability to build user-friendly interfaces utilizing storytelling techniques.
Ability to communicate technical concepts in business terms and influence decision-making.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking, with an emphasis on product development.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams

Preferred Skills

Advanced Power BI, Spotfire, or similar BI tool development and dashboarding experience is preferred
Experience with a wide array of camera, lighting, IOT integration, and edge computing solutions.
Experience with manufacturing or industrial environmental requirements affecting hardware selection
Familiarity with SCADA systems, with strong preference for Ignition.
Experience in industrial metrology, product quality, and/or chemical manufacturing
Familiarity with business reporting and common business KPIs
Statistical modeling and advanced analysis techniques
Builds collaborative relationships
Ability to influence through Storytelling

Education

BS, MS, or PhD in computer science, data science, engineering (with software focus), or closely related field (Master’s or above preferred).

Required Work Experience

Curiosity and a willingness to explore (and fail)
3-5 years of experience in computer vision, image analytics, or related fields, with at least 2 years within a manufacturing context
Proven track record of deploying models in production environments
Working knowledge of Spotfire Analytics, Power BI or similar data visualization tool
A high level of initiative and bias for action

new_jobs.description:
About Swoop:

Swoop Technologies has a mission to organize and make accessible the world’s military and critical infrastructure. We are building a distributed operating system, SwoopOS, that decomposes the world’s equipment into a distributed robotic embodiment upon which a new generation of distributed systems, autonomous systems, and agentic AI can be built and deployed using our SDK, Valhalla, and operated via our browser, Surf. Imagine the world’s equipment - consisting of the electrical grid, communications architectures, manufacturing facilities, and militaries as a trapped supply of inputs possessing the potential to ensure Western military advantage, sovereign control of economically competitive manufacturing capacity, or the creation of a grid that fosters energy dominance. Swoop is liberating these trapped assets, allowing them to contribute to the world’s future as a series of building blocks to be combined at the speed of software, limited by only the hard constraints of physics and the soft constraints of safety. That is what Swoop is building. Not in the data center or cloud or edge on-premise computing node. In the physical world. This is a hybrid position that requires someone based in Minneapolis/St. Paul OR Washington, DC who can work in-office 3+ days per week

Impact:

Swoop’s operating system challenges many paradigms defining a scalable API. Management, security, and interoperability each will be re-imagined in how Swoop’s OS exposes interfaces to inputs and outputs within the stack. You will have a role developing APIs that Swoop developers leverage to build user-facing applications running on the Swoop platform. These APIs will be further leveraged and exposed to 3rd parties to develop an ecosystem of novel applications running on the Swoop OS.

What You’ll Do:

Develop and build new services and features, working closely internally with our firmware team to interface with the SwoopOS, our frontend team to support our web application, and our infrastructure team to deliver a stable product to market.
Design and build SDK’s for internal and external use, working with 3rd parties as they develop applications to run on our OS.
Author new Python packages for common functionality used across multiple services.
Ensure our services have strong availability and service level agreements across our code base, especially as it pertains to the runtime of our Kubernetes cluster in production.
Tune data storage configurations to optimize for scale and near real-time availability in a streaming architecture.

You Should Have:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent technical experience
3+ yrs in backend software development writing scalable code and/or modern APIs structured from databases and distributed data sources
Proficient Python coding ability with good understanding of data structures and data models
Experience with Kubernetes in a production environment
Understanding of basic software security standards
Active US Security clearance or ability and willingness to be sponsored for a US Security clearance
Travel Requirement - 5-20%

Bonus if you have:

Experience with one or more of the following: async Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Solr, Rust
Experience handling multimedia data structures

Swoop Technologies is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Position Introduction/Key Duties

Cimarron is seeking a Platform Engineer
to help build, operate, and modernize the OpenShift and Kubernetes platform that hosts next-generation mission applications. In this role, you will containerize and deploy mission software, modernize CI/CD pipelines, support telemetry and machine learning workloads, and work alongside experienced NASA platform engineers to enhance platform capabilities through automation, documentation, and operational excellence.

You will design, implement, and maintain GitOps-driven deployment workflows and infrastructure automation practices, while supporting platform reliability through proactive monitoring, observability, performance tuning, incident response, and root-cause analysis. The position also includes developing and maintaining dashboards, logging, metrics, alerting, and operational reporting capabilities to ensure a secure, scalable, and resilient platform environment.

Your work will directly support the software, data, and infrastructure technologies that enable NASA flight controllers, engineers, and mission support personnel to monitor, analyze, and operate human spaceflight missions and future exploration systems.

This is a hybrid position based at NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston, TX.

Key Duties

Containerize, package and deploy mission applications (on-premises and cloud) on an OpenShift/Kubernetes cluster, applying best practices for container security, dependency management, resource planning and lifecycle operations.
Design, build and refine automated CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI, including pipeline modernization, reproducible artifacts and a multi-tenant runner strategy aligned with GitOps and DevSecOps practices.
Work alongside senior NASA platform engineers to share day-to-day cluster operations, upgrades and troubleshooting.
Write runbooks, architecture and configuration documentation, and infrastructure-as-code so the platform can be operated reliably by more than one person.
Deploy and operate the MQTT telemetry bridge and its supporting services and provide GPU and model-serving capacity for machine learning engineers.
Contribute designs for modular, scalable, loosely coupled architectures and prototypes for future missions with other NASA organizations.
Provide OpenShift, Kubernetes and containerization expertise to NASA teams, and follow NASA and JSC standards for software development and IT security.

Required/Desired Skills, Experience, And Education

Due to facility security requirements, only U.S. citizens are eligible for consideration at this time.

3 or more years of software or systems engineering experience, including 2 or more years of DevOps or platform engineering and 1 or more years operating Red Hat OpenShift or Kubernetes in production.
Hands-on experience deploying, upgrading and troubleshooting OpenShift/Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
Experience building GitLab CI pipelines and operating GitLab Runners.
Scripting and infrastructure-as-code skills (for example Ansible, Helm, Kustomize, Terraform) and Linux administration.

Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.

Red Hat certifications (EX280/EX288) or CKA/CKAD.
Experience with GitOps tooling such as Argo CD, bare metal OpenShift builds and GPU workloads on OpenShift.
Experience with hybrid on-premises and cloud infrastructure.
Keycloak or other identity provider experience.
Prior NASA, federal or other mission-critical systems experience.

Cimarron is a global solutions company with a strategic partnering approach to satisfying customer-driven requirements. We ensure customer success with a modern approach and experienced leadership. CHG shook things up in 1979 by inventing the locum tenens staffing model. We connect doctors with patients who need their care. As the largest physician staffing firm in America, our providers treat millions of patients each year.

Our industry is growing and demand is high. This means you’ll have plenty of opportunities to grow and develop in your career. Keeping healthcare healthy can be as fun as it is rewarding

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build and evolve the document management platform that CHG's staffing brands rely on every day. You'll work across the full stack: Java and Spring Boot services on the backend, and Vue.js and TypeScript on the front end as we move toward React. You'll also work with Salesforce and with event-driven services on Kafka and AWS. This is a hands-on senior role. You'll shape architecture, raise the engineering bar through code review and mentoring, and deliver in an agile team, working side by side with our Staff Engineer and every teammate. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Engineering.

Responsibilities

Build and modernize full-stack applications using Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, Vue.js and TypeScript, and help lead the gradual move from Vue to React, using AI coding tools and clear specs to move faster without lowering quality.
Design scalable microservices, RESTful APIs and event-driven integrations (Kafka) that follow our enterprise architecture principles, including integrations with Salesforce.

Collaborate closely with our Staff Engineer and every member of the team on design, planning and code review, and with product managers, designers, support teams and business stakeholders to deliver the right solution. Keep legacy services reliable while we modernize them.

Mastery of Java and Spring Boot, plus JavaScript, TypeScript and Node.js

Experience designing and consuming RESTful microservices and event-driven systems

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. Job Title

Sr. Front-End/Full Stack Developer

What does a successful Sr. Front-End/Fullstack Engineer do at Clover?

In this role, you will be a lead UI/UX-minded engineer responsible for driving the client-side evolution and expansion of our platform. While you have the full-stack capability to navigate backend APIs, your primary strength and passion lie in building exceptional web experiences, modern user interfaces, and modular frontend architectures. As part of the Loyalty Program team, you will own the user experience on the Clover Dashboard
, translating complex data into sleek, responsive web applications used by over 700k merchants worldwide. Working alongside a strong team of dedicated backend engineers, you will bridge the gap between design, product, and services—owning web client features end-to-end, evaluating modern frontend technologies, and ensuring sub-second UI responsiveness at scale.

What You Will Do

Architect, design, and develop high-performance, modular web-based frontend applications using React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript, backed by supporting Java/Spring Boot microservices.
Own the client-side architecture of the Clover Dashboard, establishing frontend best practices, state management standards, and component libraries.
Partner with Product, UX, and core Backend Engineers to translate product requirements into intuitive, reliable web workflows and clean, extensible software.
Design, consume, and optimize RESTful APIs and GraphQL/event-driven endpoints built for web clients, mobile dashboards, and 3rd-party app integrations.
Promote effective use of AI‑powered engineering tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, automated test generation, code review, and UI performance profiling) to accelerate delivery and quality.
Own client services and features from design through deployment, automated UI testing, and production monitoring.
Participate in design and code reviews, advocating for modular code, responsive design, accessibility, and clean frontend architecture.
Coach and mentor team members to improve their technical frontend capabilities, web performance optimization, and UI testing strategies.
Participate in regular release management and cross-functional agile rituals across distributed teams.

What You Will Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of software development experience, with a proven focus on Frontend / Web Engineering.
Expertise in React and TypeScript, including deep knowledge of modern client-side state management, build tooling (Webpack/Vite), and Web Performance Optimization.
Strong Full Stack capabilities: Working knowledge of Java and Spring Boot to build, update, or integrate with existing backend microservices.
Hands-on experience with modern CSS frameworks, component design systems, and responsive web design for complex dashboard interfaces.
Experience using and championing AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, automated test suites) to accelerate UI delivery.
Practical knowledge of RESTful API design, HTTP/browser protocols, web security (OAuth2, CORS), and working with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).

What Would Be Great To Have

Experience with Micro-frontend architectures (e.g., Webpack Module Federation).
Familiarity with secondary languages/tools: Python, Node.js, GraphQL, or Docker/Kubernetes containerized workflows.
Previous background in Fintech, e-commerce, POS platforms, or merchant analytics tools.
Experience re-architecting client-side monoliths into decoupled, high-availability web applications.

How You’ll Work

This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.
This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment.

Living Proof program to recognize your peers’ extra effort with points redeemable for rewards

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Business Technology
new_jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic is looking for product engineers to build internal products. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and design—you'll own outcomes, not just tasks. You'll work directly with users to understand their needs, identify the patterns behind their requests, and build the right abstractions that unlock capabilities for everyone.

What You'll Do

Rapidly design, prototype, and ship full-stack features across backend, frontend, and infrastructure
Consult with users and stakeholders to understand workflows and identify the highest-impact opportunities
Spot patterns across user requests and reduce them into primitives, platforms, or middleware that support a variety of use cases—not just one-off features
Build tools that maximize autonomy and creative freedom for less-technical users
Make product and prioritization decisions, not just execute on specs handed to you
Iterate quickly based on feedback to continuously improve the user experience
Pick up new tools, frameworks, and domains as the product evolves

You May Be a Good Fit If You

Have 6+ years of experience building production software, ideally full-stack
Can operate as a team of one when needed—you're independently capable of taking a product from idea to shipped, even if you won't always work that way
Think in systems and abstractions—you see the platform behind the feature request
Care about empowering users, not just building for them
Own outcomes, not just code—you care whether the thing you built actually solved the problem
Are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and operating with ambiguity
Hold yourself to a high bar without needing external pressure

Strong Candidates Will Have

Proficiency across the stack (we use Python, TypeScript, React)
Experience building platforms, primitives, or internal tools that others build on top of
A track record of shipping products independently—not just contributing to larger efforts

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Lead investigation and resolution of critical, high-impact production issues, including debugging across AWS services, Kubernetes workloads, data pipelines and observability tooling.

Continuously apply knowledge of current AI/LLM, cloud and observability trends to improve system design, developer productivity and business outcomes.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Demonstrated experience shipping LLM/agent systems to production — not just demos or prototypes.
Hands-on knowledge of tool calling, prompt and routing design, RAG retrieval quality tuning, and defining evaluations to measure LLM and retrieval performance.
Experience with Strands, LangGraph or Bedrock AgentCore is a plus.

Cloud, Infrastructure and Operations
Strong AWS serverless and EKS experience; able to design and debug systems spanning Lambda, API Gateway and Kubernetes-based containers in production.
Practical experience authoring and maintaining Terraform, Helm charts and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, TEP).
Observability fluency: tracing with OpenTelemetry or Dynatrace, structured logging with correlation IDs, cost tracking and incident handling.

Full-Stack and Data Pipeline Ownership
Comfortable working across Python and TypeScript/Node 24 in the service layer and React 19/Vite on the front end.
Familiar with data and retrieval pipelines from ingestion through embedding to vector-store-backed APIs.
Consistent habit of writing tests, evaluations and data-quality checks.

Delivery
Advanced delivery skills, including the ability to determine software design strategy and methodology, use automated tests and informed feedback loops to ensure quality and production readiness, and monitor the health of work efforts and adjacent systems.

Domain Expertise
Demonstrated track record of developing business partnerships and influencing priorities by identifying solutions aligned with current business objectives; closely follows industry trends relevant to the domain and shares knowledge with coworkers.

Problem Solving
Strong problem solver who uses data and proofs of concept to find creative solutions, reflects on outcomes, measures impact and uses that information to optimize — including decisions that involve a significant number of factors with broad implications.

Communication
Able to describe technology concepts in ways the business can understand, document initiatives clearly and concisely, collaborate effectively regardless of role, and give and receive constructive feedback; an attentive and empathetic listener.

Leadership
Takes action even when there is no clear owner; inspires and motivates others and is effective at influencing team members.

What is a Must Have?

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
6 additional years of software engineering experience.

What Is in It for You?

Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

At Anthropic, we're building AI systems that are safe, beneficial, and transformative. Our mission is to develop AI that benefits humanity, and we believe the most powerful capabilities emerge when we thoughtfully bridge the gap between research breakthroughs and real-world applications.

Anthropic Labs serves as our internal accelerator. We're looking for the next breakout hits that bring substantial revenue or transform an industry. We operate in close partnership with research and build through fast iteration cycles. Past successes include Claude Code and MCP.

We're seeking versatile, entrepreneurial engineers to join Labs. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and real-world application, rapidly building and testing new experiences, working directly with researchers and users, and generating the insights that shape Anthropic's product future. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity, willing to kill your own projects when the data says to, and energized by the pace of building in uncharted territory.

Responsibilities

Rapidly prototype full-stack applications that showcase emerging AI capabilities, shipping early and often to maximize learning
Collaborate closely with research teams to understand new model capabilities and translate them into intuitive user experiences
Work directly with internal test users and external partners to gather feedback, iterate quickly, and validate (or invalidate) product concepts
Design and run structured experiments to test hypotheses, balancing creative exploration with rigorous evaluation
Generate documentation and insights to guide successful prototypes toward full product teams
Advocate for user experience and product considerations early in the research process
Provide feedback to research teams about model effectiveness and where capabilities can be improved
Flexibly contribute across Labs initiatives based on organizational priorities and emerging opportunities—context from one project should inform the next

You may be a good fit if you

Have 8+ years of experience building full-stack applications, with a track record of zero-to-one work in startup or startup-like environments
Thrive in ambiguity and are energized (not anxious) by uncertainty—you're comfortable working on projects that might not exist in three months
Have a hacker mentality: high agency, bias toward shipping, comfort with technical debt when it's the right tradeoff
Are deeply user-centric—you validate ideas with actual users before over-investing and talk about problems before solutions
Can articulate learnings from failed or killed projects without defensiveness; you treat your work as experiments
Hold strong opinions loosely—you advocate forcefully for ideas but change your mind based on evidence
Are a generalist who can transition between different problem spaces as priorities shift
Work independently with good judgment about what matters, without needing constant direction
Have strong technical skills across modern web development stacks (React, Node.js, Python, etc.) and are comfortable with APIs, databases, and cloud technologies
Communicate effectively and translate complex AI capabilities into intuitive experiences
Care about the societal impacts and ethics of your work

Strong candidates may also have

Experience building products that involve AI/ML components or working with large language models
Experience collaborating directly with research teams in AI/ML environments
Background conducting user research, interviews, and usability testing
Experience across both B2B and B2C product development, or in multiple industries
Design sensibility or hands-on experience with UI/UX for AI-powered applications
Experience with real-time applications, WebSocket implementations, or complex frontend interactions

What We're Not Looking For At This Stage

Deep specialists who can't adapt if their domain becomes irrelevant
Engineers who've only succeeded in big-company structures with well-defined processes and long timelines
People who are precious about their work or frame all past projects as successes
Those who need clear roadmaps and get stressed by shifting priorities

Candidates need not have

100% of the skills listed above
Formal certifications or education credentials
Direct machine learning or AI research experience

Deadline to apply:
None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$320,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Experience leveraging AI/LLMs to build more powerful or efficient tools
Previous work in creative tools, artist tools, or other domains requiring deep user empathy
Domain knowledge in areas like human-computer interaction, systems safety, or AI alignment

We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

NBCUniversal Advertising Products & Solutions (AP&S) is responsible for the product development and project management of NBCUniversal’s full advertising technology suite. From sales support to campaign execution, delivery, and billing, our division services both internal and external customers in support of NBCUniversal’s $7B+ annual advertising business. Together, we’re building the platform that powers the future of advertising at NBCU.

Our Data Collaboration Group, a core part of AP&S, powers the full advertiser lifecycle across insights, measurement, onboarding, activation, and optimization, utilizing various integration pathways including Data Clean Rooms and secure data shares.

Within the Data Collaboration Group, our Engineering & Operations team builds the automation and platform capabilities behind these workflows. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Automation Engineering to join the Engineering & Operations team. Reporting to the Director of Automation Engineering, this role will build AI-enabled automation systems and production-grade software that support NBCUniversal’s data collaboration ecosystem. 

The ideal candidate is a strong Python engineer who can design reliable systems, productize repeatable workflows, and build AI agents that help automate complex engineering and operational tasks across data platforms for audience activation, measurement, and reporting.

AI Agent & Automation Engineering

Agent Evaluation & Reliability
